title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops

paragraphs.en: System One models choose an agent’s next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. Where the probed facts provably determine the action, models that read every fact still fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the failure. On real states, what is missing is often not a fact but the next sub-goal.
paragraphs.zh: 系统一模型通过单次处理所提供的选项集，为每个选项打分，从而选择智能体的下一个动作。 这使得它们快速且成本低廉，但一旦做出错误选择，便无从追溯：是模型误读了智能体所看到的信息，还是在正确读取后仍做出了错误行动？我们通过行为分析来回答这个问题。 在由模拟环境生成的、包含智能体决策状态的固定基准测试中，我们针对客户服务的策略、工具使用、网页导航和编程等任务，将每个“下一个动作”问题与关于同一状态的事实性探询配对，且每个探询均独立回答。 在十七个快速系统和一个推理模型中，结果始终一致：大多数错误行动都发生在正确读取信息之后，而系统越准确，其错误中采取这种形式的比例就越高。 这些错误并非随机噪声；它们在不同类型的系统中，针对相同的状态反复出现。 当被探询的事实能够明确决定动作时，那些能读取每个事实的模型仍然无法将这些事实整合起来，而由代码生成的自身答案则能修复这一缺陷。 在真实状态中，缺失的往往不是某个事实，而是下一个子目标。

paragraphs.en: An agent acting in an environment repeatedly reads the feedback of its previous actions, works out where it stands, and chooses what to do next. In most current agents each such step is a call to a large language model that writes out its reasoning and then names an action ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . A growing family of System One models takes a different route ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; Liquid AI, 2026 ; Kwok et al., 2026 ; Palmer, 2026 ; Convai Innovations, 2026 ; Cloudflare, 2026 ) . Given the agent’s state and a set of candidate answers, they return a probability distribution over the supplied options and generate no text; their output is consumed directly by code, and their developers emphasize intelligence per dollar ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . The System One models we evaluate answer a complete state in a median of 27–225 ms, against 317–947 ms for likelihood readouts of open-weight language models and 2.3 s for a reasoning model (§ 4 ). We study only their choice interface , in which the model selects among supplied options.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在环境中行动时，会反复读取其先前行动的反馈，评估自身当前状态，并选择下一步行动。 在大多数现有智能体中，每一步操作都会调用一个大语言模型，该模型会先写出推理过程，然后指定一个具体行动（Yao et al., 2023）。 一系列不断发展的“系统一”模型采取了不同的路径（TypeSafe AI, 2026；Liquid AI, 2026；Kwok et al., 2026；Palmer, 2026；Convai Innovations, 2026；Cloudflare, 2026）。 在给定智能体的状态和一组候选答案时，这些模型会返回所提供选项的概率分布，且不会生成任何文本；其输出由代码直接处理，开发者强调其“每美元带来的智能水平”（TypeSafe AI, 2026）。 我们评估的“系统一”模型处理完整状态的平均耗时为 27–225 毫秒，而开放权重语言模型的似然度读取需要 317–947 毫秒，推理模型则需要 2.3 秒（§ 4）。 我们仅研究其选择接口，即模型在给定选项中进行选择的过程。

sents.zh: 我们仅研究其选择接口，即模型在给定选项中进行选择的过程。

paragraphs.en: When such a model picks the wrong action, there is no chain of thought to read. The error has two very different explanations. The model may have misread what the agent already knows, for example by missing that the last action failed or losing track of what it holds; or it may have read all of it correctly and still chosen badly . The first points to the state representation or the context budget, the second to the decision itself. Final-action accuracy cannot tell these cases apart, and generated rationales need not reflect the computation behind an answer ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Lanham et al., 2023 ) . Conversely, a correct action does not show that the model understood the trace.
paragraphs.zh: 当这类模型选错动作时，就没有可供解读的思维链条。 这个错误有两种截然不同的解释。 模型可能误解了智能体已知的内容，例如没有注意到最后一个动作失败了，或者忘记了它当前持有的信息；也可能它完全正确理解了所有信息，但仍然做出了糟糕的选择。 第一种情况指向状态表示或上下文预算问题，而第二种情况则指向决策本身的问题。 最终动作的准确率无法区分这些情况，且生成的推理过程未必能反映答案背后的计算过程（Turpin et al., 2023; Lanham et al., 2023）。 反之，一个正确的动作并不能说明模型理解了其中的推理过程。

sents.zh: 当这类模型选错动作时，就没有可供解读的思维链条。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask, behaviorally: can System One models understand the information an agent has obtained and act correctly on it, and when they fail, can we tell failures of comprehension from failures of decision? On a single agent decision state we ask, each in isolation, the next-action question and factual probes whose answers the environment determines, such as whether the last action succeeded, what the agent carries, or whether an action is permitted. Crossing “all measured facts correct” with “action correct” gives four observable outcomes (Figure 1 ). Around this measurement we build a frozen benchmark of 65,228 records, 19,663 of them paired test states, from simulators with exact ground truth (ALFWorld, BabyAI-Text, TextWorld), customer-service policies ( τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench), tool use, web navigation and coding traces, with every admissible action in context and gold labels computed only from what the agent has seen. We evaluate seventeen fast systems, fourteen System One models of three kinds (hosted APIs, open-weight models, and recipes that read a frozen language model) and three likelihood readouts of open-weight language models, with a reasoning model, GPT-6.1, as a reference.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们从行为角度提出一个问题：系统一模型能否理解智能体获取的信息并据此正确行动？当它们失败时，我们能否区分理解失败与决策失败？ 针对单个智能体的决策状态，我们分别对其提出“下一步行动”问题以及由环境决定答案的事实性探询，例如上一次行动是否成功、智能体携带了什么物品，或某项行动是否被允许。 将“所有测得的事实均正确”与“行动正确”相结合，可得出四种可观察的结果（图1）。 基于这一测量结果，我们构建了一个包含65,228条记录的固定基准数据集，其中19,663条为成对的测试状态。这些数据来自具有精确真实标签的模拟器（ALFWorld、BabyAI-Text、TextWorld）、客户服务策略（τ²-bench）、工具使用、网页导航和编码轨迹；所有允许的行动均包含在上下文中，而黄金标签仅基于智能体已观察到的内容计算得出。 我们评估了十七个快速系统，包括三种类型的十四套系统一模型（托管API、开放权重模型以及读取固定语言模型的配方），以及三种基于开放权重语言模型的可能性输出，并以推理模型GPT-6.1作为参考。

sents.zh: 将“所有测得的事实均正确”与“行动正确”相结合，可得出四种可观察的结果（图1）。

sents.en: We evaluate seventeen fast systems, fourteen System One models of three kinds (hosted APIs, open-weight models, and recipes that read a frozen language model) and three likelihood readouts of open-weight language models, with a reasoning model, GPT-6.1, as a reference.
sents.zh: 我们评估了十七个快速系统，包括三种类型的十四套系统一模型（托管API、开放权重模型以及读取固定语言模型的配方），以及三种基于开放权重语言模型的可能性输出，并以推理模型GPT-6.1作为参考。

paragraphs.en: The short answer is that these models mostly read right and act wrong. Our main findings are:
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之，这些模型大多能正确理解，却无法正确行动。我们的主要发现是：

paragraphs.en: Most wrong actions follow correct reading. For the six most accurate systems, 73–85% of decision errors occur on states where every measured fact is answered correctly, and the share grows with accuracy (§ 5.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 大多数错误行为都发生在正确阅读之后。 对于六个最准确的系统而言，73%–85%的决策错误出现在所有已测量事实均被正确回答的状态中，且这一比例会随着准确性的提高而上升（§ 5.1）。

sents.en: Most wrong actions follow correct reading.
sents.zh: 大多数错误行为都发生在正确阅读之后。

sents.en: For the six most accurate systems, 73–85% of decision errors occur on states where every measured fact is answered correctly, and the share grows with accuracy (§ 5.1 ).
sents.zh: 对于六个最准确的系统而言，73%–85%的决策错误出现在所有已测量事实均被正确回答的状态中，且这一比例会随着准确性的提高而上升（§ 5.1）。

paragraphs.en: The errors are structured. All 14 competent fast systems fail with every fact right on the same 141 states, where chance predicts none (§ 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些错误是有结构的。 所有 14 个称职的快速系统，在每一个事实都正确的情况下，都会在所有相同的 141 个状态中失败，而概率预测在这些状态中无一成功（§ 5.3）。

sents.en: The errors are structured.
sents.zh: 这些错误是有结构的。

sents.en: All 14 competent fast systems fail with every fact right on the same 141 states, where chance predicts none (§ 5.3 ).
sents.zh: 所有 14 个称职的快速系统，在每一个事实都正确的情况下，都会在所有相同的 141 个状态中失败，而概率预测在这些状态中无一成功（§ 5.3）。

paragraphs.en: When the probes suffice, the failure is composition. On generated states whose probes determine the action, models that read every fact and decide perfectly from the facts alone lose 20–45 points when they must do both from the trace. Their own fact answers recover 15–28 points, and composing the action in code from them reaches 0.96–1.00 (§ 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当探针足够时，失败源于组合。 在生成的状态中，若探针决定了行动，那么那些仅通过读取所有事实并据此完美决策的模型，在必须从轨迹中同时完成两项任务时，会损失 20–45 分。 它们自身对事实的回答能恢复 15–28 分，而通过代码将这些回答组合成行动，则能达到 0.96–1.00（§ 6.1）。

sents.en: When the probes suffice, the failure is composition.
sents.zh: 当探针足够时，失败源于组合。

sents.en: On generated states whose probes determine the action, models that read every fact and decide perfectly from the facts alone lose 20–45 points when they must do both from the trace.
sents.zh: 在生成的状态中，若探针决定了行动，那么那些仅通过读取所有事实并据此完美决策的模型，在必须从轨迹中同时完成两项任务时，会损失 20–45 分。

sents.en: Their own fact answers recover 15–28 points, and composing the action in code from them reaches 0.96–1.00 (§ 6.1 ).
sents.zh: 它们自身对事实的回答能恢复 15–28 分，而通过代码将这些回答组合成行动，则能达到 0.96–1.00（§ 6.1）。

paragraphs.en: On real states, the decision itself is often missing. Correct answers to the benchmark’s probes add at most 7 points for all but two systems. On ALFWorld, stating the next sub-goal adds 16 points for JEV, any block of facts at most 5 (§ 6.2 , § 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在真实状态中，决策本身往往缺失。 对于基准测试中的探测问题，正确回答最多为除两个系统外的所有系统增加 7 分。 在 ALFWorld 中，陈述下一个子目标可为 JEV 增加 16 分，而任何事实块最多只能增加 5 分（§ 6.2、§ 6.3）。

sents.en: On real states, the decision itself is often missing.
sents.zh: 在真实状态中，决策本身往往缺失。

sents.en: Correct answers to the benchmark’s probes add at most 7 points for all but two systems.
sents.zh: 对于基准测试中的探测问题，正确回答最多为除两个系统外的所有系统增加 7 分。

sents.en: On ALFWorld, stating the next sub-goal adds 16 points for JEV, any block of facts at most 5 (§ 6.2 , § 6.3 ).
sents.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，陈述下一个子目标可为 JEV 增加 16 分，而任何事实块最多只能增加 5 分（§ 6.2、§ 6.3）。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy hides the rest. Removing the history collapses accuracy where earlier observations matter, policy edits are read correctly but acted on in only 22–72% of cases, and calibration error ranges from 2.6% to 26.6% (§ 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 准确性掩盖了其余问题。 移除历史数据会导致准确性下降，尤其是在早期观察结果重要的情况下；策略调整虽然能被正确读取，但在实际执行中的成功率仅为 22%–72%，且校准误差在 2.6% 到 26.6% 之间（§ 7）。

sents.en: Accuracy hides the rest.
sents.zh: 准确性掩盖了其余问题。

sents.en: Removing the history collapses accuracy where earlier observations matter, policy edits are read correctly but acted on in only 22–72% of cases, and calibration error ranges from 2.6% to 26.6% (§ 7 ).
sents.zh: 移除历史数据会导致准确性下降，尤其是在早期观察结果重要的情况下；策略调整虽然能被正确读取，但在实际执行中的成功率仅为 22%–72%，且校准误差在 2.6% 到 26.6% 之间（§ 7）。

paragraphs.en: We also contribute a model-free criterion for when probes can support attributing an error to the decision (§ 2.4 ), states that satisfy it by construction, and an evaluation of eighteen systems that combines the paired diagnostics with cost, latency and calibration. The paired outcomes are behavioral evidence: they do not identify a model’s internal computation, and we do not claim that the probes exhaust every relevant fact.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还提出了一种无模型的标准，用于判断探针是否能够将错误归因于决策（§ 2.4）；文中还说明了哪些状态通过构造满足该标准，并对十八个系统进行了评估，将成对诊断与成本、延迟和校准相结合。 这些成对的结果属于行为证据：它们并未揭示模型内部的计算过程，我们也不声称这些探针涵盖了所有相关事实。

paragraphs.en: On annotated states we also ask closed factual probes whose answers the simulator state, database or data labels determine: the outcome of the last action, the agent’s location and inventory, completed subgoals, whether an action is permitted, and which observation establishes a fact. paragraphs.en: that is, if some action is correct in every state the agent could be in given those answers. If two states share the correct probe answers but have disjoint gold sets, answering every probe correctly cannot determine the action, and a wrong action after correct probes cannot be attributed to deciding alone. Pairwise intersections are not enough; the check must consider the whole group. In finite environments it is exhaustive; in natural data, absence of a counterexample does not prove sufficiency. Passing it means the probes can support a diagnosis, not that the model uses those facts.
paragraphs.zh: 也就是说，如果智能体在给定这些答案的情况下可能处于的任何状态中，某个动作都是正确的。 如果两个状态共享相同的正确探针答案，但它们的黄金集合互不相交，那么即使所有探针的答案都正确，也无法确定该动作；而在正确探针之后采取错误动作，也不能归因于仅凭探针结果做出的决策。 成对交集并不足够；检查必须考虑整个群体。 在有限环境中，这种方法是穷举的；但在自然数据中，没有反例并不能证明其充分性。 通过这一检验意味着探针能够支持诊断，并不意味着模型确实使用了这些事实。

paragraphs.en: To see what drives the outcomes, the benchmark also contains a trace ablation that removes the executed history, observation minimal pairs that edit only the last observation relevantly or irrelevantly, stated rule changes that make prior knowledge wrong, and difficulty ladders over trace length and the distance from the decisive observation (§ 7 ); encoding controls are not analyzed here (Appendix B.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究驱动结果的因素，该基准测试还包含一项轨迹消融分析：它移除了执行历史、仅对相关或不相关的最后一个观察进行编辑的观察最小对、使先前知识失效的明确规则变更，以及针对轨迹长度和决定性观察距离的难度阶梯（§ 7）；编码控制在此未作分析（附录 B.5）。

paragraphs.en: The frozen benchmark has 65,228 records, 59,234 test and 5,994 dev (Table 6 in Appendix C ). Most paired states come from three simulators with exact ground truth: ALFWorld, BabyAI-Text and TextWorld cooking games ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Paglieri et al., 2025 ; Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ; Carta et al., 2023 ; Côté et al., 2018 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . Trajectories are rolled out by each environment’s expert, by a noisy variant and by a variant that issues invalid commands, so traces contain failures and detours; no language model takes part. Gold sets were checked against breadth-first search in the real environments. From τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench airline and retail ( Barres et al., 2026 ) we take policy-constrained states with tool calls enumerated from the database and probes on record fields and permissions. Tool selection, web navigation and AgentRM trees ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Patil et al., 2025 ; Ross et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) carry probes on fields stated in the trace (the visible-field probes), and 360 coding records built from real repository histories ask which edit caused a regression and which limited next action follows. Ladders vary trace length, distance from the decisive observation and novelty, and confirmation cohorts generated later from new seeds re-test the findings on states no earlier run had seen. A further 32,700 records of text-understanding primitives are part of the frozen population but not analyzed here.
paragraphs.zh: 该冻结基准数据集包含 65,228 条记录，其中测试集为 59,234 条，开发集为 5,994 条（见附录 C 中的表 6）。 大多数配对状态来自三个具有精确真实值的模拟器：ALFWorld、BabyAI-Text 和 TextWorld 烹饪游戏（Shridhar 等，2021；Paglieri 等，2025；Chevalier-Boisvert 等，2019；Carta 等，2023；Côté 等，2018；Cui 等，2025）。 轨迹由每个环境的专家、一个带有噪声的变体以及一个会发出无效命令的变体生成，因此轨迹包含失败和绕路情况；语言模型未参与此过程。 黄金数据集在真实环境中通过与广度优先搜索的结果进行了验证。 我们从 τ₂ -bench 的航空和零售场景（Barres 等，2026）中选取了策略受限的状态，这些状态的工具调用从数据库中枚举得出，并对记录字段和权限进行了探测。 工具选择、网页导航和 AgentRM 树（Xu 等，2026；Shi 等，2025；Patil 等，2025；Ross 等，2025；Deng 等，2023；Xia 等，2025）对轨迹中声明的字段进行了探测（即可见字段探测），此外，基于真实代码库历史构建的 360 条编码记录用于判断哪项编辑引发了回归，以及哪项限制影响了后续动作。 Ladders 数据集变化了轨迹长度、与决定性观察点的距离和新颖度，并通过从新种子生成的确认组重新测试了早期运行中未见过的状态，以验证研究结果。 另外 32,700 条文本理解基础操作记录也属于该冻结数据集，但本文未对其进行分析。

paragraphs.en: Records are split into dev and test by source (game, user, repository), and every request byte, option order and label is frozen in a hash-sealed manifest before analysis. An independent content audit flagged 98 test records, which we keep and treat in a sensitivity analysis (§ 5.4 ). Because fixed public items can be overfit, the follow-up studies also use freshly generated states, including states whose probes are sufficient by construction (§ 6.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists the seventeen fast systems and the reasoning reference, grouped by type. The fourteen System One models return a native distribution over the supplied options in one pass: two hosted APIs, JEV and OpenAI Decisions; ten released open-weight models, served locally from pinned revisions with their authors’ code and settings; and two recipes that read a frozen open-weight language model through the same interface. Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.5-9B are read out by complete-option likelihood with thinking disabled, which gives a distribution of the same form. GPT-6.1 Sol (medium reasoning) answers each question in a separate call with the selected option and a verbalized distribution; it is a reference with deliberation, not a competitor.
paragraphs.zh: 表1按类型分组列出了十七个快速系统以及推理参考。 十四种“系统一”模型在一次处理中即返回所提供选项上的原生分布：两个托管API（JEV和OpenAI Decisions）；十个已发布的开放权重模型，通过固定版本从本地提供服务，并包含其作者提供的代码和设置；以及两种通过相同接口读取冻结开放权重语言模型的方案。 Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B和Qwen3.5-9B通过完整选项似然度进行输出，同时禁用思考功能，从而得到相同形式的分布。 GPT-6.1 Sol（中等推理）通过单独调用回答每个问题，每次提供所选选项和语言化的分布；它作为一个带有审慎过程的参考模型，而非竞争模型。

paragraphs.en: Every system receives the same frozen requests, and we never truncate a state, drop options or reselect records. A question beyond a system’s documented input limit is recorded as unsupported, counted wrong and reported as coverage; this matters mainly for Laya, Quyet-1.0-Large (which refuses more than ten options, including every ALFWorld decision), Perplexity Decider-27B, and the servers of Vega-27B and SimpleJev-27B on the longest states (Appendix D ). A system that answers fewer than half of the questions of an analysis is left out of it and named (the coverage rule ). Readouts differ by design, so comparisons are between deployed choice interfaces and do not isolate architecture, size or training data. All systems receive all 65,228 records.
paragraphs.zh: 每个系统都接收到相同的固定请求，我们绝不会截断状态、丢弃选项或重新选择记录。 超出系统文档规定输入限制的问题会被记录为不支持，计为错误，并报告为覆盖范围问题；这对 Laya、Quyet-1.0-Large（拒绝超过十个选项，包括所有 ALFWorld 决策）、Perplexity Decider-27B，以及最长状态下 Vega-27B 和 SimpleJev-27B 的服务器尤为重要（附录 D）。 如果某个系统回答的分析问题少于总数的一半，它将被排除在该分析之外并予以命名（覆盖范围规则）。 读取结果因设计而异，因此比较是在已部署的选择界面之间进行的，并未隔离架构、规模或训练数据。 所有系统都接收全部 65,228 条记录。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy runs batch requests, so we time a separate latency panel of 163 test items, one per difficulty cell, answered strictly one item at a time after five warm-up items; we report the first pass on complete answers (Table 1 ). Systems marked there are estimated from their sequential accuracy runs; GPT-6.1 is timed through its synchronous API with an item’s questions sent in parallel (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于准确性测试是按批处理请求的，因此我们对 163 个测试项目进行了单独的延迟面板计时，每个难度单元格一个项目，在回答五个热身项目后严格逐个回答；我们报告首次完整作答的时间（表 1）。 其中标记的系统是根据其顺序准确性测试估算得出的；GPT-6.1 则是通过其同步 API 进行计时的，每个项目的提问是并行发送的（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: JEV was billed $8.79 for all 65,228 records ($0.13 per 1,000 decision states) and OpenAI Decisions $18.69 ($0.29). For self-hosted systems we estimate cost from the panel’s time per state at a stated GPU price. The efficient frontier (Figure 2 ) runs from Laya and Kev-9B through Cygnet, Decider-chat-31B and JEV to Eikos-27B, which reaches 0.795 at about 1.4 times JEV’s cost, and Gemma-4-31B (0.811 at about five times). GPT-6.1 reaches 0.884 for $642 under batch pricing, about 73 times JEV per state. Hosted models can change between versions: a rerun of JEV’s decisions five days after the formal run matched on 96.3% of 2,783 states (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: JEV 因全部 65,228 条记录被收取 8.79 美元的费用（每 1,000 个决策状态 0.13 美元），而 OpenAI Decisions 的费用为 18.69 美元（0.29 美元）。 对于自托管系统，我们根据面板中每个状态所需的时间以及给定的 GPU 价格来估算成本。 有效前沿（图 2）从 Laya 和 Kev-9B 开始，经过 Cygnet、Decider-chat-31B 和 JEV，最终到达 Eikos-27B；Eikos-27B 在约 JEV 成本的 1.4 倍时达到 0.795，而 Gemma-4-31B 在约五倍成本时达到 0.811。 GPT-6.1 在批量定价下以 642 美元的成本达到 0.884，相当于每个状态 JEV 成本的约 73 倍。 托管模型可以在不同版本之间切换：在正式运行五天后重新运行 JEV 的决策，与 2,783 个状态中的 96.3% 相匹配（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: We first ask how often measured comprehension and action correctness come apart, how costly the errors are, and whether they are idiosyncratic to a model or attached to particular states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先探讨的是，所测量的理解能力与行动正确性在何种情况下会出现分离，这些错误会带来多大的代价，以及它们是属于某个模型的特有现象，还是与特定状态相关。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 and Figure 3 give the four outcomes for all eighteen systems on the same 19,663 states. For the six most accurate systems, 73–85% of all decision errors occur on states where every measured fact is answered correctly. Conditional on all measured facts being correct, the action is still wrong in 10–21% of states. The converse also holds: when at least one fact is answered wrongly, the action is nevertheless correct in 62–70% of states. Neither direction of the pairing is a reliable proxy for the other.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 和图 3 展示了所有十八个系统在相同的 19,663 个状态下的四种结果。 在六个最准确的系统中，73%–85% 的所有决策错误都发生在每个已测量事实都被正确回答的状态中。 在所有已测量事实均正确的条件下，仍有 10%–21% 的状态中采取的行动是错误的。 反之亦然：当至少有一个事实被错误回答时，在 62%–70% 的状态中采取的行动仍然是正确的。 这种配对的任一方向都不能作为另一方向的可靠替代指标。

paragraphs.en: The share of errors that follow correct reading grows with accuracy (Figure 3 b). Among the fast systems above 0.5 accuracy it ranges from 49% (Kev-9B) to 81% (Gemma), and it is 85% for the reasoning reference, GPT-6.1. Stronger systems mainly stop misreading; they do not stop choosing wrongly after reading correctly. Deliberation helps: GPT-6.1 raises decision accuracy to 0.884, 7 points above Gemma and 9–12 points above the three most accurate System One models (Eikos-27B, Clef and JEV), at about 70 times JEV’s cost per state (§ 4 ). But its remaining errors are of the same kind, and in an even larger proportion. CLM-8B, Laya and Quyet-1.0-Large rarely answer both the probes and the action correctly (U1D1 1.1%, 0.4% and 2.7%), largely because of input limits that we count as wrong (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在正确阅读之后出现的错误所占比例会随着准确率的提高而增加（图 3b）。 在准确率高于 0.5 的快速系统中，这一比例从 Kev-9B 的 49% 到 Gemma 的 81% 不等，而对于推理参考模型 GPT-6.1，该比例为 85%。 性能更强的系统主要能避免误读；但在正确阅读之后，它们并不会停止做出错误选择。 深思熟虑有助于提升表现：GPT-6.1 将决策准确率提升至 0.884，比 Gemma 高出 7 个百分点，比三个最准确的 System One 模型（Eikos-27B、Clef 和 JEV）高出 9–12 个百分点，而其每个状态的成本仅为 JEV 的约 70 倍（第 4 节）。 但它剩余的错误类型相同，且所占比例甚至更高。 CLM-8B、Laya 和 Quyet-1.0-Large 很少能同时正确回答探测问题和执行动作（U1D1 分别为 1.1%、0.4% 和 2.7%），这主要归因于输入限制，而这些限制我们视为错误（第 4 节）。

sents.zh: 在正确阅读之后出现的错误所占比例会随着准确率的提高而增加（图 3b）。

sents.en: CLM-8B, Laya and Quyet-1.0-Large rarely answer both the probes and the action correctly (U1D1 1.1%, 0.4% and 2.7%), largely because of input limits that we count as wrong (§ 4 ).
sents.zh: CLM-8B、Laya 和 Quyet-1.0-Large 很少能同时正确回答探测问题和执行动作（U1D1 分别为 1.1%、0.4% 和 2.7%），这主要归因于输入限制，而这些限制我们视为错误（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: The pattern does not depend on the type of system. Among the System One models, the hosted APIs make 73% (JEV) and 70% (OpenAI Decisions) of their errors after correct reading, the open-weight models above 0.5 accuracy from 49% (Kev-9B) to 79% (Torchcast-27B; 78% for Eikos-27B, the most accurate System One model at 0.795), and the two readouts of a frozen LLM 62% (Decider-chat-31B) and 78% (Cygnet); the LLM likelihood readouts make 56–81%. Systems differ in how often a correct reading still leads to the wrong action: OpenAI Decisions acts wrongly in 26% of states with every fact right, Torchcast-27B in 30% and SimpleJev-27B in 36%, against 17–21% for the five most accurate fast systems; SimpleJev-27B, which reads well ( U U = 0.758) but decides correctly on only 0.592 of paired states, thus makes 68% of its errors after correct reading. Torchcast-27B is the clearest case: it reads better than any other System One model ( U U = 0.858, second among fast systems only to Gemma) but decides correctly on only 0.678 of paired states, the largest gap between reading and acting of any competent system, so that 79% of its errors follow correct reading; it is weakest on ALFWorld (0.565). Perplexity Decider-27B and Decider-chat-31B rarely act correctly after a misread fact ( P ⁡ ( D | U = 0 ) P(D\,|\,U{=}0) 0.38 and 0.50), partly because a refused or shortened long state counts against both the probes and the decision (on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, with the longest states, they reach 0.53 and 0.48); Vega-27B, strong in TextWorld (0.880), is weak on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench and on the visible-field probes (0.60 and 0.61), where its server fails on the longest states.

paragraphs.en: The pattern is not driven by one domain (Figure 4 ). Among the six strongest systems, the share of errors after correct reading is 68–82% in ALFWorld, 62–100% in BabyAI, 80–94% in TextWorld and 77–90% in τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench. Two panels make the dissociation especially visible. On a TextWorld cohort generated after all earlier runs, JEV and Gemma both answer every probe correctly, yet their decision accuracies are 95.0% and 73.2%; Gemma has 161 of 600 states with all facts right and the action wrong, against 30 for JEV. On coding traces, both choose the correct next action on all 300 test states while answering the paired probes at 85.2% and 97.1%. A saturated action score here hides a twelve-point difference in what the models read correctly. Rankings also change across domains: among the fast systems, Decider-chat-31B, Gemma and Clef lead on ALFWorld (0.81–0.82), JEV on TextWorld and on the visible-field probes, and Eikos-27B on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench (0.843), while GPT-6.1, strongest everywhere else, is the weakest of the six strongest systems on τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench (0.709). The reason is a preference for caution rather than misreading. On τ 2 \tau^{2} states whose gold action is a tool call, typically a write the user has just confirmed, GPT-6.1 replies to the user instead in 16.7% of cases, against 2.8–7.0% for Gemma, Qwen3.8-27B, Clef and JEV, and calls a read-only tool to re-verify in another 5.3%; together these account for 80% of its errors there. Where the correct next step is to reply, it is more accurate than these four (0.695 vs. 0.34–0.64). Because τ 2 \tau^{2} gold actions come from successful trajectories, this extra caution is scored as an error.
paragraphs.zh: 这种模式并非由单一领域驱动（图4）。 在六个最强的系统中，正确阅读后的错误率在 ALFWorld 中为 68–82%，在 BabyAI 中为 62–100%，在 TextWorld 中为 80–94%，在 τ²-bench 中为 77–90%。 两个面板使这种分离现象尤为明显。 在一个在所有先前运行之后生成的 TextWorld 数据集上，JEV 和 Gemma 都能正确回答每个探针问题，但它们的决策准确率分别为 95.0% 和 73.2%；在 600 个状态中，Gemma 有 161 个状态的事实全部正确但动作错误，而 JEV 仅有 30 个。 在编码轨迹上，两者在所有 300 个测试状态下都选择了正确的下一步动作，同时配对探针的准确率分别为 85.2% 和 97.1%。 此处饱和的动作得分掩盖了模型正确阅读内容上的十二个百分点的差异。 排名在不同领域之间也会变化：在快速系统中，Decider-chat-31B、Gemma 和 Clef 在 ALFWorld（0.81–0.82）中领先，JEV 在 TextWorld 和可见字段探针中领先，而 Eikos-27B 在 τ²-bench（0.843）中领先；相比之下，在其他所有领域表现最强的 GPT-6.1，在 τ²-bench 中却是六个最强系统中表现最弱的（0.709）。 其原因是模型更倾向于谨慎行事，而非误读。 在 τ² 状态中，若黄金动作是工具调用（通常是用户刚刚确认的写操作），GPT-6.1 在 16.7% 的情况下会转而回复用户，而 Gemma、Qwen3.8-27B、Clef 和 JEV 的这一比例仅为 2.8–7.0%；此外，它还会调用仅读工具进行重新验证，这种情况占另外 5.3%。这两类错误合计占其在此处所有错误的 80%。 当正确的下一步是回复时，它的准确率高于上述四个模型（0.695 对比 0.34–0.64）。 由于 τ² 的黄金动作来自成功轨迹，这种额外的谨慎行为会被计为错误。

paragraphs.en: A wrong action can be a harmless detour or a dead end. In the three simulators we replay every wrong decision and compute its regret by exact lookahead (Figure 5 ). Pooled over the 14 competent fast systems (paired decision accuracy above 0.5, coverage rule passed), most errors cost at most one extra step: 86–90% in ALFWorld, 42–56% in BabyAI and 77–84% in TextWorld, the range spanning errors after correct reading and after a misread fact. Where the two kinds of error differ, errors after a misread fact are the costlier ones. In BabyAI, 58% of them cost two or more steps, against 44% of errors after correct reading; in TextWorld, 20% are unrecoverable, against 6%. For Gemma in TextWorld the unrecoverable share is 24% after a misread fact and 2% otherwise. ALFWorld is the exception: almost nothing is unrecoverable there, and errors after correct reading are, if anything, slightly costlier (14% vs. 10% cost two or more extra steps). Between 5% and 42% of a system’s “wrong” decisions, depending on the system and the simulator, are in fact also optimal under exact lookahead, which bounds how much of the measured error comes from gold sets that are stricter than necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的行动可能是一次无害的绕道，也可能是一条死路。 在这三种模拟器中，我们重演了每一个错误决策，并通过精确的前瞻计算其后悔值（图5）。 在14个表现良好的快速系统（成对决策准确率高于0.5且通过覆盖规则）中综合来看，大多数错误最多只会多耗费一步：ALFWorld中为86%–90%，BabyAI中为42%–56%，TextWorld中为77%–84%；这一范围涵盖了正确读取事实和误读事实后出现的错误。 在这两种错误存在差异的情况下，误读事实后产生的错误代价更高。 在BabyAI中，这类错误中有58%会耗费两步或更多，而正确读取事实后的错误中这一比例为44%；在TextWorld中，20%的错误无法挽回，而后者仅为6%。 对于TextWorld中的Gemma而言，误读事实后无法挽回的错误占比为24%，而在其他情况下仅为2%。 ALFWorld是个例外：其中几乎没有任何错误是无法挽回的，而且正确读取事实后的错误代价甚至略高（14% vs. 10%会耗费两步或更多额外步骤）。 在不同系统和模拟器中，一个系统的“错误”决策中有5%到42%实际上在精确前瞻下也是最优的，这为所测得错误中有多少源于比必要更严格的黄金数据集设定了上限。

paragraphs.en: The reasoning reference changes this picture. GPT-6.1 makes few errors after a misread fact in the simulators (124 in ALFWorld, none in BabyAI, 21 in TextWorld), and a large part of its errors after correct reading are not errors at all: exact lookahead shows that the chosen action is also optimal for 34% of them in ALFWorld, 64% in BabyAI and 96% in TextWorld. As decision accuracy rises, gold sets that admit only some of the optimal actions account for a growing share of the measured error, and the headline share of errors after correct reading (85% for GPT-6.1) includes many such cases. Exact lookahead is therefore a necessary complement to set-valued gold when strong models are compared.
paragraphs.zh: 推理参考改变了这幅图景。 在模拟器中，GPT-6.1 在误读事实后仅出现少量错误（ALFWorld 中有 124 个，BabyAI 中无，TextWorld 中有 21 个），而在正确阅读后的错误中，很大一部分根本并非错误：精确前瞻显示，在 ALFWorld 中，所选动作对其中 34% 的情况也是最优的；在 BabyAI 中为 64%，在 TextWorld 中为 96%。 随着决策准确性的提高，仅允许部分最优动作的黄金数据集在测量错误中所占的比例逐渐增大，而正确阅读后错误的总体比例（GPT-6.1 为 85%）也包含了大量此类情况。 因此，在比较强模型时，精确前瞻是集合值黄金标准所必需的补充。

paragraphs.en: If facts-right, action-wrong errors were idiosyncratic noise, they would be spread evenly over states. They are not (Figure 6 ). Of the 53,382 such events produced by the 14 competent fast systems, 56% fall on states where at least seven of the 14 fail in this way, against 16% under a null that permutes each system’s events within its frozen cells, and 85% on states shared by at least three (78% under the null). All 14 systems fail with every fact right on the same 141 states, where the null expects none, and each of them decides correctly on 74–94% of the states that no other competent system fails but on only 1–16% of those that all thirteen others fail (Figure 6 b). The errors are therefore attached to properties of particular states, which makes them worth explaining (§ 6 ); and a benchmark that samples such states is a sharper diagnostic than one that weights all states equally. Deliberation resolves many of them but not all: GPT-6.1, accurate on 88% of all paired states, chooses correctly on only 40% of the 141 states that defeat every competent fast system, and 62% of its own facts-right, action-wrong errors fall on states where at least three of them also fail.

paragraphs.en: A facts-right, action-wrong outcome may also come from a wrong label. Two audits bound this. An independent content audit found 42 test records with conflicting labels and 56 whose inputs also occur in dev; excluding these 98 records changes no group score of any of the eighteen systems by more than 3.5 points (§ C.4 ). Second, while building the decision-oriented probes of § 6.3 we re-derived every ALFWorld label from the text of the trace alone. In the original ALFWorld cohorts, several receptacles can share one simulator location, and the builder recorded only one of them. For 303 paired test records, the location label therefore names a co-located receptacle rather than the one the text says the agent arrived at, and the four strong systems we audited answer the receptacle named in the text (98–99%), so these records cannot reach U = 1 U{=}1 (Appendix E ). The later confirmation cohort uses set-valued labels and is unaffected. Excluding the 398 affected ALFWorld records raises the share of errors made after correct reading for every audited system (on ALFWorld, from 0.663 to 0.707 for JEV and from 0.810 to 0.885 for Gemma). We keep the frozen labels and report this as a sensitivity analysis. It makes our headline estimate conservative.
paragraphs.zh: 事实正确但行动错误的情形也可能源于错误的标签。两次审计对此进行了约束。 一次独立的内容审计发现，有 42 条测试记录的标签存在冲突，另有 56 条的输入也出现在开发环境中；排除这 98 条记录后，十八个系统中任何一组得分的变化均不超过 3.5 分（§ C.4）。 其次，在构建 § 6.3 中的决策导向探针时，我们仅根据轨迹文本重新推导了所有 ALFWorld 标签。 在原始的 ALFWorld 数据集中，多个容器可能共享同一个模拟器位置，而构建者仅记录了其中一个。 因此，对于 303 对测试记录，位置标签所指的容器与其共存于同一位置，而非文本中智能体实际到达的那个容器；我们审计的四个强系统在文本中命名的容器上的正确率分别为 98%–99%，所以这些记录无法达到 U = 1（附录 E）。 后续的确认数据集使用集合值标签，因此不受影响。 排除受影响的 398 条 ALFWorld 记录后，每个被审计系统在正确阅读后仍出现错误的比例均有所上升（在 ALFWorld 上，JEV 的比例从 0.663 升至 0.707，Gemma 的比例从 0.810 升至 0.885）。 我们保留这些固定的标签，并将此结果作为敏感性分析报告。 这使得我们的主要估计值更为保守。

paragraphs.en: A facts-right, action-wrong outcome on a natural state has two readings. The probes may have missed a decision-relevant fact (§ 2.4 ), or the model may have read everything it needed and still not combined it into the right action. On natural states the two cannot be separated, so we first build states where they can, and then return to real benchmark states. Figure 7 summarizes the three studies. Each adds information to the decision request and measures the change on the same states; requests that contain a system’s own answers are built from its earlier answers to the same probes, asked alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在自然状态下，事实正确而行动错误的结果存在两种解读。 探针可能遗漏了与决策相关的事实（§ 2.4），或者模型可能已经读取了所有所需信息，却仍未将其整合为正确的行动。 在自然状态下，这两者无法被区分，因此我们首先构建能够区分它们的州，然后再回到真实的基准状态。 图 7 总结了这三项研究。 每一项都为决策请求增添了信息，并在相同的州上测量其变化；包含系统自身答案的请求，是依据该系统先前单独回答相同探针的结果构建的。

paragraphs.en: We generate decision states in two domains, a household text world and a customer service policy. Each state has a goal, a numbered decision list of four rules followed by a default action (“apply the first rule whose condition holds”), an executed trace that establishes eight binary facts, and a fixed set of nine actions. Four of the facts are tested by the rules; the other four are distractors, each tied to a plausible action outside the procedure, and any fact may be established and then overwritten by later feedback. The ladder variable is the position of the first rule whose condition holds (1–4, or none, so that the default applies). Later rules hold independently with probability 0.5, so that choosing a later rule whose condition also holds (a precedence error) can be told apart from choosing a rule whose condition does not hold. For every assignment of the four rule facts the gold action is unique, which we verify by enumeration. The probes ask the four rule facts and two of the distractors, so correct answers to the rule-fact probes determine the action, and U = 1 , D = 0 U{=}1,D{=}0 can only be a failure to use facts that were read. On the same 1,200 test states (120 per domain and ladder position) we ask the decision under four inputs: the raw trace; the trace plus the current values of the four rule facts; the trace plus the current values of the four distractor facts, in the same form (a control for added text); and the values of all eight facts without the trace.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个领域生成决策状态：一个家庭文本世界和一个客户服务策略。 每个状态都有一个目标、一个包含四条规则后跟默认动作（“应用条件满足的第一条规则”）的编号决策列表、一个确立八个二元事实的执行轨迹，以及一个固定的九个动作集合。 四个事实会被规则检验；另外四个是干扰项，每个都与流程之外的一个合理动作相关联，并且任何事实都可能在之后被反馈覆盖。 阶梯变量是条件满足的第一条规则的位置（1–4，或不存在，此时应用默认动作）。 后续规则以 0.5 的概率独立成立，因此选择另一个条件也满足的后续规则（优先顺序错误）可以被识别出来，与选择条件不满足的规则区分开来。 对于四个规则事实的每一种赋值，黄金动作都是唯一的，我们通过枚举法验证了这一点。 探针会询问四个规则事实和两个干扰项，因此对规则事实探针的正确回答可以确定动作，而 U = 1, D = 0 只能是未能使用已读取的事实所致。 在相同的 1,200 个测试状态（每个领域和阶梯位置各 120 个）上，我们在四种输入条件下提出决策问题：原始轨迹；轨迹加上四个规则事实的当前值；轨迹加上四个干扰项事实的当前值（以相同形式呈现，作为额外文本的对照）；以及不包含轨迹的八个事实的全部值。

paragraphs.en: Every system shown in Figure 8 a answers the rule-fact probes almost perfectly on the raw trace (97–100%). JEV and Qwen3.8-27B also decide perfectly when given the facts alone (1.000 and 0.994). Yet from the raw trace their decision accuracy is 0.791 and 0.797, a gap of 20 points between two abilities that each work in isolation. Appending the correct values of the relevant facts to the trace closes the gap (0.974 and 0.967), while appending the same amount of irrelevant text widens it (0.751 and 0.705). Gemma shows no gap at all (0.991 from the trace), and Cygnet lies in between, with 0.992 from the facts alone and 0.881 from the trace. For Clef, Qwen3.5-9B and Kev-9B even the facts-only condition is imperfect (0.71–0.87), so they also fail to apply the rules. For the fast systems, almost none of the errors comes from not knowing a fact (97–100% of JEV’s, Qwen3.8-27B’s and Cygnet’s errors have all four rule facts right). They come from choosing what to act on. The reasoning reference is the exception: GPT-6.1 decides at 0.928 from the trace and at 1.000 from the facts, but only 26 of its 86 errors have all four rule facts right, and 62 apply a rule whose condition does not hold. When it reasons before answering, composition is no longer the bottleneck and the remaining errors are misreadings, spread evenly over facts that were and were not overwritten later in the trace (2.6% and 2.3% of probes).
paragraphs.zh: 图8a中展示的所有系统在原始轨迹上对规则-事实探问的回答几乎完美（97–100%）。 JEV和Qwen3.8-27B在仅给出事实时也能做出完美决策（1.000和0.994）。 然而，从原始轨迹来看，它们的决策准确率分别为0.791和0.797，这两个独立工作的能力之间存在20个百分点的差距。 将相关事实的正确值附加到轨迹上可以消除这一差距（0.974和0.967），而附加同等量的无关文本则会扩大差距（0.751和0.705）。 Gemma完全没有表现出这种差距（从轨迹得出的准确率为0.991），而Cygnet则介于两者之间，仅从事实得出的准确率为0.992，从轨迹得出的准确率为0.881。 对于Clef、Qwen3.5-9B和Kev-9B而言，即使仅在事实条件下，结果也不完美（0.71–0.87），因此它们也无法正确应用规则。 对于快速系统而言，几乎没有任何错误源于不了解某个事实（JEV、Qwen3.8-27B和Cygnet的错误中，97–100%的情况都正确掌握了全部四个规则事实）。 这些错误源于对应当采取何种行动的选择。 推理参考是例外情况：GPT-6.1从轨迹得出的决策准确率为0.928，从事实得出的准确率为1.000，但其86个错误中只有26个正确掌握了全部四个规则事实，另有62个错误应用了条件不成立的规则。 当系统在回答前进行推理时，组合能力不再是瓶颈，其余错误则是对信息的误读，这些误读均匀地分布在轨迹中后期被覆盖和未被覆盖的事实上（分别占探问的2.6%和2.3%）。

sents.zh: JEV和Qwen3.8-27B在仅给出事实时也能做出完美决策（1.000和0.994）。

sents.en: Yet from the raw trace their decision accuracy is 0.791 and 0.797, a gap of 20 points between two abilities that each work in isolation.
sents.zh: 然而，从原始轨迹来看，它们的决策准确率分别为0.791和0.797，这两个独立工作的能力之间存在20个百分点的差距。

sents.en: Appending the correct values of the relevant facts to the trace closes the gap (0.974 and 0.967), while appending the same amount of irrelevant text widens it (0.751 and 0.705).
sents.zh: 将相关事实的正确值附加到轨迹上可以消除这一差距（0.974和0.967），而附加同等量的无关文本则会扩大差距（0.751和0.705）。

sents.en: Gemma shows no gap at all (0.991 from the trace), and Cygnet lies in between, with 0.992 from the facts alone and 0.881 from the trace.
sents.zh: Gemma完全没有表现出这种差距（从轨迹得出的准确率为0.991），而Cygnet则介于两者之间，仅从事实得出的准确率为0.992，从轨迹得出的准确率为0.881。

sents.en: For Clef, Qwen3.5-9B and Kev-9B even the facts-only condition is imperfect (0.71–0.87), so they also fail to apply the rules.
sents.zh: 对于Clef、Qwen3.5-9B和Kev-9B而言，即使仅在事实条件下，结果也不完美（0.71–0.87），因此它们也无法正确应用规则。

sents.en: For the fast systems, almost none of the errors comes from not knowing a fact (97–100% of JEV’s, Qwen3.8-27B’s and Cygnet’s errors have all four rule facts right).
sents.zh: 对于快速系统而言，几乎没有任何错误源于不了解某个事实（JEV、Qwen3.8-27B和Cygnet的错误中，97–100%的情况都正确掌握了全部四个规则事实）。

sents.en: They come from choosing what to act on.
sents.zh: 这些错误源于对应当采取何种行动的选择。

sents.en: The reasoning reference is the exception: GPT-6.1 decides at 0.928 from the trace and at 1.000 from the facts, but only 26 of its 86 errors have all four rule facts right, and 62 apply a rule whose condition does not hold.
sents.zh: 推理参考是例外情况：GPT-6.1从轨迹得出的决策准确率为0.928，从事实得出的准确率为1.000，但其86个错误中只有26个正确掌握了全部四个规则事实，另有62个错误应用了条件不成立的规则。

sents.en: When it reasons before answering, composition is no longer the bottleneck and the remaining errors are misreadings, spread evenly over facts that were and were not overwritten later in the trace (2.6% and 2.3% of probes).
sents.zh: 当系统在回答前进行推理时，组合能力不再是瓶颈，其余错误则是对信息的误读，这些误读均匀地分布在轨迹中后期被覆盖和未被覆盖的事实上（分别占探问的2.6%和2.3%）。

paragraphs.en: The remaining eight System One models separate the two abilities just as cleanly: seven of them decide perfectly from the facts alone (1.000). Four of them also nearly close the gap from the raw trace: Decider-chat-31B, Perplexity Decider-27B, Quyet-1.0-Large and Eikos-27B decide at 0.95–0.98, and most of their few errors (19–63) are precedence errors with all facts right. Torchcast-27B comes close (0.938 from the trace, a gap of 6 points); its 75 errors, all but one with every fact right, are spread over precedence, distractor and default actions. OpenAI Decisions repeats the pattern of JEV and Qwen3.8-27B: 0.792 from the trace, 0.964 with the relevant facts appended and 0.757 with irrelevant ones; 232 of its 250 errors have all four rule facts right. A gap of 20 points between reading and composing is therefore not a property of one model family, but neither is it universal among fast decision models. Vega-27B shows a gap of its own: it reads the facts (0.999) but decides at 0.691 from the trace, 0.918 from the facts alone and 0.520 when irrelevant facts are appended, and 216 of its 371 errors act on a true fact outside the procedure, the capture failure we see for Clef. SimpleJev-27B has the largest gap of any system: it decides perfectly from the facts alone but at 0.551 from the trace and 0.451 with irrelevant facts appended, and 299 of its 539 errors act on a fact outside the procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 其余八个 System One 模型同样能清晰地区分这两种能力：其中七个仅凭事实就能做出完美决策（1.000）。 其中四个模型在仅依据原始轨迹时的表现也几乎弥补了这一差距：Decider-chat-31B、Perplexity Decider-27B、Quyet-1.0-Large 和 Eikos-27B 的决策准确率在 0.95–0.98 之间，且它们为数不多的错误（19–63 个）大多是前提条件错误，而所有事实均正确。 Torchcast-27B 的表现接近这一水平（根据轨迹得出 0.938，差距为 6 个百分点）；其 75 个错误中除一个外，所有错误的事实部分均正确，这些错误分布于前提条件、干扰项和默认动作中。 OpenAI Decisions 重复了 JEV 和 Qwen3.8-27B 的模式：根据轨迹得出 0.792，附加相关事实后为 0.964，附加无关事实后则为 0.757；其 250 个错误中有 232 个在四个规则事实均正确的情况下发生。 因此，阅读与决策之间存在 20 个百分点的差距，并非某个模型家族的专属特性，也并非所有快速决策模型都普遍存在。 Vega-27B 展现出自身的独特差距：它能正确读取事实（0.999），但根据轨迹决策时准确率仅为 0.691，仅凭事实决策时为 0.918，附加无关事实后则降至 0.520；其 371 个错误中有 216 个是基于流程之外的正确事实所做出的错误操作，这正是我们在 Clef 中观察到的捕获失败问题。 SimpleJev-27B 是所有系统中差距最大的模型：仅凭事实它能做出完美决策，但根据轨迹决策时准确率仅为 0.551，附加无关事实后则降至 0.451；其 539 个错误中有 299 个是基于流程之外的某个事实所做出的错误操作。

paragraphs.en: JEV never applies a rule whose condition is false (OpenAI Decisions does, in 149 of its 250 errors, at least 131 of them with all four rule facts answered correctly). Its 251 errors on the raw trace apply a later rule whose condition is also true, skipping an earlier one (125, precedence ), act on a true fact that is outside the procedure (103, distractor ), or fall back to the default action although a rule applies (23). Across systems (Figure 8 b), the errors of Clef, Vega-27B and SimpleJev-27B are mostly distractor actions, the few errors of Quyet-1.0-Large, Eikos-27B and Decider-chat-31B mostly precedence errors, and those of GPT-6.1 and OpenAI Decisions mostly false rules. We test four explanations with targeted rewrites of the same states (Figure 8 c). Rewriting observations as neutral statements changes nothing for JEV (+0.5), so the wording of observations is not the cause. Moving the decisive evidence to the end of the trace helps (+7.9 in rule order, +10.8 reversed), and removing the distractor facts also helps (+7.8), but neither removes the precedence errors. Only a summary of the facts in one place recovers the facts-only level. For JEV and Qwen3.8-27B, the failure is therefore one of consolidating evidence scattered over a trace before applying an ordered rule. Clef behaves differently: removing distractor facts alone raises its accuracy by 33 points, to 0.924, so its dominant failure is capture by out-of-procedure cues. The same benchmark thus separates two mechanisms that yield the same outcome.
paragraphs.zh: JEV 从不应用条件为假的规定（OpenAI Decisions 却这样做了，在其 250 个错误中有 149 个属于这种情况，其中至少 131 个错误中所有四个规则事实的回答都是正确的）。 它在原始轨迹上的 251 个错误涉及应用一个条件也为真的后续规则，从而跳过了一个先前的规则（125 个为优先级错误），作用于一个位于流程之外的真实事实（103 个为干扰项错误），或在有适用规则的情况下回退到默认动作（23 个）。 在不同系统中（图 8b），Clef、Vega-27B 和 SimpleJev-27B 的错误主要是干扰项动作；Quyet-1.0-Large、Eikos-27B 和 Decider-chat-31B 的少数错误主要是优先级错误；而 GPT-6.1 和 OpenAI Decisions 的错误则主要是假规则。 我们通过针对相同状态的定向改写，测试了四种解释（图 8c）。 将观察结果改写为中性陈述对 JEV 没有任何影响（+0.5），因此观察结果的措辞并非原因。 将决定性证据移至轨迹末尾会有所帮助（规则顺序方面 +7.9，反向处理则 +10.8），移除干扰项事实也有帮助（+7.8），但这两种方法都无法消除优先级错误。 只有在某处对事实进行汇总，才能恢复到仅基于事实的水平。 因此，对于 JEV 和 Qwen3.8-27B 而言，其失败在于未能先整合分散在轨迹中的证据，再应用有序规则。 Clef 的行为则不同：仅移除干扰项事实就使其准确率提升了 33 个点，达到 0.924，因此其主要失败是受到流程之外提示的干扰。 因此，同一基准测试区分了两种产生相同结果的机制。

paragraphs.en: Because these models read the facts correctly, they can supply the summary themselves. Appending each system’s own probe answers (asked in separate requests) recovers almost all of the gap: JEV rises from 0.791 to 0.968 (+17.7), Qwen3.8-27B to 0.955 (+15.8), Qwen3.5-9B to 0.767 (+20.3) and Clef to 0.747 (+15.4; its self-written summaries are identical to the correct ones on 1,197 of 1,200 states). GPT-6.1 gains nothing (0.928 to 0.931): its errors are misreadings, and its own summaries repeat them (114 wrong fact values over the 1,200 states). OpenAI Decisions recovers most of its gap from its own answers (0.792 to 0.937, +14.5, CI [+12.1, +16.8]), although its summaries contain 63 wrong fact values; Vega-27B gains about as much as Qwen3.5-9B (0.691 to 0.890, +19.9, CI [+17.7, +22.2]) with only 5 wrong fact values; SimpleJev-27B gains the most of all (0.551 to 0.827, +27.6, CI [+25.1, +30.2]) despite 148 wrong fact values; Torchcast-27B closes its smaller gap (0.938 to 0.994, +5.7, CI [+4.3, +7.0]); the four systems near ceiling gain 1.3–2.7 points. Composing the action in code from the model’s own fact answers, which is possible here because the rules are explicit, is better still: 0.996 for JEV, 0.987 for Qwen3.8-27B, 1.000 for Clef and 0.965 for Qwen3.5-9B. The second request can be reserved for uncertain states: using the native confidence of the first decision, a cascade that re-asks only below a confidence of 0.7 reaches 0.932 for JEV with a second request on 38% of states. This is the usage pattern that System One models are designed for: many narrow questions in parallel, combined by code ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由于这些模型能正确读取事实，因此它们可以自行生成摘要。 附加每个系统通过单独请求获得的自身探测答案后，几乎完全弥补了性能差距：JEV 从 0.791 提升至 0.968（+17.7），Qwen3.8-27B 提升至 0.955（+15.8），Qwen3.5-9B 提升至 0.767（+20.3），而 Clef 则提升至 0.747（+15.4；在 1,200 个状态中，有 1,197 个状态的自写摘要与正确摘要完全一致）。 GPT-6.1 并未获得任何提升（从 0.928 到 0.931）：其错误源于误读，而自身生成的摘要也重复了这些错误（在 1,200 个状态中出现了 114 个错误的事实值）。 OpenAI Decisions 通过自身答案弥补了大部分性能差距（从 0.792 提升至 0.937，+14.5，置信区间 [+12.1, +16.8]），尽管其摘要包含 63 个错误的事实值；Vega-27B 的提升幅度与 Qwen3.5-9B 大致相当（从 0.691 提升至 0.890，+19.9，置信区间 [+17.7, +22.2]），但仅包含 5 个错误的事实值；SimpleJev-27B 的提升幅度最大（从 0.551 提升至 0.827，+27.6，置信区间 [+25.1, +30.2]），尽管存在 148 个错误的事实值；Torchcast-27B 则缩小了其较小的差距（从 0.938 提升至 0.994，+5.7，置信区间 [+4.3, +7.0]）；接近上限的四个系统性能提升了 1.3–2.7 分。 根据模型自身提供的事实答案，通过代码合成具体行动（在此可行，因为规则是明确的），效果更佳：JEV 达到 0.996，Qwen3.8-27B 达到 0.987，Clef 达到 1.000，Qwen3.5-9B 达到 0.965。 第二个请求可用于处理不确定的状态：利用首次决策的原始置信度，构建一个仅在置信度低于 0.7 时重新提问的级联流程，可使 JEV 达到 0.932，且第二个请求仅用于 38% 的状态。 这正是 System One 模型的设计使用模式：并行处理大量特定问题，并通过代码（TypeSafe AI, 2026）进行整合。

sents.zh: OpenAI Decisions 通过自身答案弥补了大部分性能差距（从 0.792 提升至 0.937，+14.5，置信区间 [+12.1, +16.8]），尽管其摘要包含 63 个错误的事实值；Vega-27B 的提升幅度与 Qwen3.5-9B 大致相当（从 0.691 提升至 0.890，+19.9，置信区间 [+17.7, +22.2]），但仅包含 5 个错误的事实值；SimpleJev-27B 的提升幅度最大（从 0.551 提升至 0.827，+27.6，置信区间 [+25.1, +30.2]），尽管存在 148 个错误的事实值；Torchcast-27B 则缩小了其较小的差距（从 0.938 提升至 0.994，+5.7，置信区间 [+4.3, +7.0]）；接近上限的四个系统性能提升了 1.3–2.7 分。

sents.en: Composing the action in code from the model’s own fact answers, which is possible here because the rules are explicit, is better still: 0.996 for JEV, 0.987 for Qwen3.8-27B, 1.000 for Clef and 0.965 for Qwen3.5-9B.
sents.zh: 根据模型自身提供的事实答案，通过代码合成具体行动（在此可行，因为规则是明确的），效果更佳：JEV 达到 0.996，Qwen3.8-27B 达到 0.987，Clef 达到 1.000，Qwen3.5-9B 达到 0.965。

sents.en: The second request can be reserved for uncertain states: using the native confidence of the first decision, a cascade that re-asks only below a confidence of 0.7 reaches 0.932 for JEV with a second request on 38% of states.
sents.zh: 第二个请求可用于处理不确定的状态：利用首次决策的原始置信度，构建一个仅在置信度低于 0.7 时重新提问的级联流程，可使 JEV 达到 0.932，且第二个请求仅用于 38% 的状态。

sents.en: This is the usage pattern that System One models are designed for: many narrow questions in parallel, combined by code ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 这正是 System One 模型的设计使用模式：并行处理大量特定问题，并通过代码（TypeSafe AI, 2026）进行整合。

paragraphs.en: Does the remedy transfer to natural states? We sample 2,783 paired test states (25 per frozen cell, all domains) and ask the decision alone, after the benchmark’s probe questions, after the system’s own earlier probe answers, or after the correct answers (Table 3 , Figure 9 a). The effect is small for every system but two. For the other fast systems, correct answers add 2.9–7.1 points, the system’s own answers 2.1–4.7 and merely asking the questions 0.6–3.0; GPT-6.1, which decides alone at 0.902, gains 1.3 points from the correct answers and 0.4 from its own. Most of the benefit of the own answers is therefore already obtained by listing the questions: the answers themselves add at most 2.1 points, and nothing distinguishable from zero for JEV, Kev-9B, Qwen3.5-9B and Perplexity Decider-27B. SimpleJev-27B and Torchcast-27B are the exceptions. Deciding alone at 0.656, SimpleJev-27B gains 10.1 points from the correct answers and 9.1 from its own, 5.6 of them beyond the questions; Torchcast-27B, alone at 0.715, gains 8.6 from the correct answers and 7.3 from its own, but 5.4 of them already from the questions, mostly on ALFWorld (correct answers +20.2 there). The small net gain hides larger movements. For Qwen3.8-27B, JEV, Gemma and Clef, the own answers repair 34%, 32%, 27% and 25% of the facts-right, action-wrong states, but break 2–4% of the states that were correct, which are about five times as many. OpenAI Decisions’ own answers repair 33% of its facts-right, action-wrong states, as many as for JEV, but break 6.8% of the correct ones, the most of any system. Quyet-1.0-Large answers only 547 of the 2,783 states (it refuses option lists longer than ten); on those, no condition changes its accuracy measurably (0.808 alone).
paragraphs.zh: 这种补救措施能否迁移到自然状态？ 我们采样了 2,783 个成对的测试状态（每个冻结单元格 25 个，涵盖所有领域），并在基准测试的探测问题之后、系统自身的早期探测答案之后，或正确答案之后，单独询问决策结果（表 3，图 9a）。 除了两个系统外，其他所有系统的效应都很小。 对于其他快速系统，正确答案可增加 2.9–7.1 分，系统自身的答案可增加 2.1–4.7 分，而仅提问可增加 0.6–3.0 分；GPT-6.1 单独决策的得分为 0.902，通过正确答案获得 1.3 分增益，通过自身答案获得 0.4 分增益。 因此，系统自身答案带来的大部分好处，其实已经通过列出问题获得了：答案本身最多只能增加 2.1 分，而对于 JEV、Kev-9B、Qwen3.5-9B 和 Perplexity Decider-27B，其增益甚至无法与零区分。 SimpleJev-27B 和 Torchcast-27B 是例外。 SimpleJev-27B 单独决策的得分为 0.656，通过正确答案获得 10.1 分增益，通过自身答案获得 9.1 分增益，其中 5.6 分来自提问；Torchcast-27B 单独决策的得分为 0.715，通过正确答案获得 8.6 分增益，通过自身答案获得 7.3 分增益，但其中 5.4 分已来自提问，主要是在 ALFWorld 上（正确答案在此处增加了 +20.2 分）。 微小的净增益掩盖了更大的变化。 对于 Qwen3.8-27B、JEV、Gemma 和 Clef，系统自身的答案修复了事实正确但行动错误的状态中 34%、32%、27% 和 25%，但也破坏了原本正确的状态中的 2–4%，而后者数量约为前者的五倍。 OpenAI Decisions 的自身答案修复了其事实正确但行动错误的状态中的 33%，与 JEV 相当，但也破坏了 6.8% 的正确状态，是所有系统中破坏比例最高的。 Quyet-1.0-Large 仅对 2,783 个状态中的 547 个给出了答案（它拒绝超过十个选项的列表）；在这些状态中，没有任何条件能显著改变其准确率（单独决策时为 0.808）。

paragraphs.en: The contrast with § 6.1 is the point. There, the probes were sufficient and their answers determined the action; here, even the correct answers to the benchmark probes leave most errors in place. The probes were designed to measure reading, not to specify the decision, so they do not carry the missing information.
paragraphs.zh: 与 § 6.1 的对比正是关键所在。 在那部分，探测问题足够充分，其答案决定了后续行动；而在此处，即便对基准探测问题的回答正确，大多数错误仍然存在。 这些探测问题旨在衡量理解能力，而非明确决策本身，因此它们并不包含缺失的信息。

paragraphs.en: If the bottleneck is what the probes ask, probes designed for the decision should do better. On 644 ALFWorld states we derive, from the text of the trace alone, everything a planner would need: the agent’s location and inventory, where each still-needed object was last seen, whether the held object has been cleaned, heated or cooled, how many objects are already in place, which receptacles have not yet been visited, and the next sub-goal (search, fetch, take, go to the appliance, process, go to the destination, place, use the lamp). We validate the parse against the simulator labels (§ 5.4 ) and ask each fact as a narrow, independent question, about 26 per state. We then add to the decision request either the decision-oriented facts, a complete digest of the observed state, the next sub-goal, or facts plus sub-goal, each with correct values, and the same blocks filled with each system’s own answers (Table 4 , Figure 9 b).
paragraphs.zh: 如果瓶颈在于智能体提出的请求，那么为决策而设计的智能体应该表现得更出色。 在 644 个 ALFWorld 状态中，仅从轨迹文本中，我们就能推导出规划者所需的一切信息：智能体的位置和物品清单、每个仍需要的物品最后出现的位置、所持有的物品是否已被清洁、加热或冷却、已有多少个物品放置在正确位置、哪些容器尚未被访问，以及下一个子目标（搜索、取物、拿取、前往设备处、处理、前往目的地、放置、使用灯具）。 我们将解析结果与模拟器的标签（§ 5.4）进行验证，并将每个事实作为独立且具体的问题提出，每个状态约提出 26 个问题。 随后，我们在决策请求中添加决策导向的事实、观察到的状态的完整摘要、下一个子目标，或事实与子目标的组合，并分别使用正确的值填充；同时，也用各系统自身的答案填充相同的区块（表 4，图 9b）。

sents.en: If the bottleneck is what the probes ask, probes designed for the decision should do better.
sents.zh: 如果瓶颈在于智能体提出的请求，那么为决策而设计的智能体应该表现得更出色。

paragraphs.en: JEV answers the narrow probes almost perfectly: 99.7% of the 14,104 visited-or-not questions, 100% for the held object and placed count, 96.9% for where needed objects were seen. Yet decision-oriented facts add only 5.3 points, no more than the benchmark’s own probes (5.7), and a complete state digest adds 4.7. Stating the next sub-goal adds 16.3 points, and facts plus sub-goal 21.3, reaching 0.929. JEV’s own answer to the sub-goal question is right in only 66.8% of states, so the same block filled with its own answers adds 6.4. Of JEV’s 183 errors when deciding alone, 41% have every fact right but the sub-goal wrong, and another 37% have both right when asked separately: JEV can state the sub-goal it then fails to pursue. For JEV, the remaining errors on real ALFWorld states are errors of planning, not of reading or of consolidation.
paragraphs.zh: JEV 对狭窄探测问题的回答几乎完美：在 14,104 个“是否访问过”的问题中正确率高达 99.7%，对于已持有物品和放置数量的问题正确率为 100%，对于需要看到物品位置的问题正确率为 96.9%。 然而，决策导向的事实仅增加了 5.3 分，不超过基准模型自身探测问题的得分（5.7），而完整的状态摘要仅增加了 4.7 分。 陈述下一个子目标可增加 16.3 分，事实与子目标结合则增加 21.3 分，达到 0.929。 JEV 自身对子目标问题的回答在仅 66.8% 的状态中是正确的，因此用其自身答案填充的相同模块仅增加了 6.4 分。 在 JEV 单独决策时出现的 183 个错误中，有 41% 的情况是事实全部正确但子目标回答错误，另有 37% 的情况是在分别提问时两者都正确：JEV 能够陈述子目标，但随后未能执行该目标。 对于 JEV 而言，在真实 ALFWorld 状态中剩余的错误属于规划错误，而非阅读或整合错误。

paragraphs.en: The same blocks help Clef, Gemma and Qwen3.8-27B much less: no block adds more than 10 points, and the sub-goal adds about 6. Their own answers help only Qwen3.8-27B (+4.8 with facts, +6.2 with facts and sub-goal); for Clef and Gemma they change nothing ( − 1.2 -1.2 to + 0.3 +0.3 ). GPT-6.1 decides alone at 0.953 and no block, correct or its own, adds more than 2.5 points. How well a system answers the sub-goal question does not predict whether its answers help. Clef answers it best (89.1%) and gains nothing; of Clef’s errors when deciding alone, nearly half (48%) occur with every fact and the sub-goal answered correctly in separate requests. Qwen3.8-27B answers it worst (36.0%, below its own decision accuracy) and still gains, through the facts; GPT-6.1 answers it equally poorly (35.2%) while deciding correctly in 95% of states, so its decisions do not pass through the sub-goal as the benchmark labels it. The decision-oriented facts can even hurt: on states where one needed object has been seen and another has not, listing the unvisited receptacles sends Gemma and Qwen3.8-27B to search instead of fetching what they already know about, and Gemma’s accuracy on these states falls from 0.659 to 0.341. With every block given, most of Gemma’s remaining errors pick the right kind of action for the wrong object. Extra information is not neutral: a salient but incomplete summary can pull a model away from the trace it otherwise reads well.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的模块对 Clef、Gemma 和 Qwen3.8-27B 的帮助要小得多：没有哪个模块能增加超过 10 分，而子目标仅增加约 6 分。 它们自己的答案只对 Qwen3.8-27B 有帮助（有事实时 +4.8，同时有事实和子目标时 +6.2）；对 Clef 和 Gemma 而言，这些答案没有任何影响（从 −1.2 到 +0.3）。 GPT-6.1 单独决策的准确率为 0.953，且没有任何模块——无论是正确模块还是它自己的模块——能增加超过 2.5 分。 一个系统对子目标问题的回答质量，并不能预测其答案是否会有所帮助。 Clef 的回答最准确（89.1%），但并未因此获得任何提升；在 Clef 单独决策时出现的错误中，近一半（48%）发生在所有事实和子目标都在单独请求中被正确回答的情况下。 Qwen3.8-27B 的回答最差（36.0%，低于其单独决策的准确率），但通过事实仍然获得了提升；GPT-6.1 的回答同样糟糕（35.2%），尽管它在 95% 的状态下都能正确决策，因此它的决策并未像基准标签所标示的那样经过子目标。 以决策为导向的事实甚至可能产生负面影响：在需要看到某个物体但尚未看到另一个物体的状态下，列出未访问的容器会促使 Gemma 和 Qwen3.8-27B 转而搜索，而不是获取它们已经知道的信息；在这些状态下，Gemma 的准确率从 0.659 下降到了 0.341。 在提供所有模块后，Gemma 剩余的多数错误都表现为为错误的物体选择了正确的行动类型。 额外信息并非中性：一个突出但不完整的摘要可能会使模型偏离原本能够正确遵循的推理路径。

sents.en: Clef answers it best (89.1%) and gains nothing; of Clef’s errors when deciding alone, nearly half (48%) occur with every fact and the sub-goal answered correctly in separate requests.

paragraphs.en: The seven other System One models that answer ALFWorld decisions confirm that the sub-goal is the most useful single block: it adds 6.7–13.8 points for six of them (OpenAI Decisions +11.0, CI [+7.2, +14.9]; Eikos-27B +13.8), while decision-oriented facts add 0.9–3.3 points, except for Vega-27B (+5.0) and Eikos-27B (+8.9), which gains 18.5 from facts plus sub-goal. Torchcast-27B repeats JEV’s pattern more strongly: deciding alone at only 0.486, it gains 27.5 points from the sub-goal and 34.6 from facts plus sub-goal (to 0.832), more than any other system, answers the sub-goal question correctly in only 60% of states, and 53% of its errors when deciding alone have every fact right but the sub-goal wrong. Like Clef and Gemma rather than JEV, the others mostly answer the sub-goal question well (0.77–0.87; SimpleJev-27B 0.64), and 32–64% of their errors when deciding alone occur with every fact and the sub-goal answered correctly in separate requests. Their own answers help less than the correct ones, and OpenAI Decisions’ own facts and sub-goal even lower its accuracy ( − 2.6 -2.6 , CI [ − 7.1 -7.1 , + 1.9 +1.9 ]). The pull of an incomplete summary also recurs: on the states where one needed object has been seen and another has not, correct decision facts lower OpenAI Decisions from 0.698 to 0.543 and Decider-chat-31B from 0.698 to 0.434, although Vega-27B and Torchcast-27B gain on the same states (0.713 to 0.806 and 0.302 to 0.496).
paragraphs.zh: 另外七个回答 ALFWorld 决策的系统一模型证实，子目标是单个模块中最为有用的：对其中六个模型而言，它能增加 6.7–13.8 分（OpenAI Decisions +11.0，CI [+7.2, +14.9]；Eikos-27B +13.8），而决策导向的事实仅能增加 0.9–3.3 分，但 Vega-27B（+5.0）和 Eikos-27B（+8.9）除外，后者从事实与子目标的结合中获得了 18.5 分。 Torchcast-27B 更明显地重复了 JEV 的模式：仅靠决策时其得分仅为 0.486，但从子目标中获得了 27.5 分，从事实与子目标的结合中获得了 34.6 分（达到 0.832），超过任何其他系统；然而，它在仅 60% 的状态下能正确回答子目标问题，并且在单独决策时，有 53% 的错误是事实全部正确但子目标错误。 与 JEV 不同，其他模型大多像 Clef 和 Gemma 一样能很好地回答子目标问题（0.77–0.87；SimpleJev-27B 为 0.64），并且在单独决策时，有 32–64% 的错误发生在事实与子目标在分别提问时均被正确回答的情况下。 它们自己提供的答案帮助程度不如正确答案，而 OpenAI Decisions 自身提供的事实和子目标甚至降低了其准确性（−2.6，CI [−7.1, +1.9]）。 不完整摘要的负面影响也再次出现：在需要看到某个物体但尚未看到另一个物体的状态下，正确的决策事实使 OpenAI Decisions 的得分从 0.698 降至 0.543，Decider-chat-31B 的得分从 0.698 降至 0.434；不过 Vega-27B 和 Torchcast-27B 在同一状态下反而获得了提升（分别从 0.713 升至 0.806，以及从 0.302 升至 0.496）。

paragraphs.en: Across these studies, the source of a facts-right, action-wrong error varies by system and by state: consolidation of scattered evidence for JEV and Qwen3.8-27B on rule procedures, capture by irrelevant cues for Clef, sub-goal selection for JEV on household tasks, and grounding a sub-goal in the right object for Gemma. Each calls for a different remedy, and only the paired measurement, combined with probes that are sufficient for the decision, reveals which applies.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些研究中，“事实正确、行为错误”这一错误的来源因系统和状态而异：JEV 和 Qwen3.8-27B 在规则程序方面存在零散证据的整合问题；Clef 则受到无关线索的影响；JEV 在执行家庭任务时会出现子目标选择问题；而 Gemma 则是将子目标错误地关联到了错误的对象上。 每种情况都需要不同的解决方案，只有结合配对测量与足以揭示决策过程的关键探针，才能确定究竟是哪一种情况适用。

paragraphs.en: Removing the executed history leaves BabyAI almost unchanged (JEV 73.3 → \to 70.1%; Gemma even rises from 75.5% to 79.9%), since the current view largely determines the next step, but it collapses the states that require remembering an earlier observation (Figure 10 a). On the ALFWorld distance ladder, every strong system falls to between 14% and 24% (JEV 87.2 → \to 13.7%, Gemma 92.6 → \to 22.6%, Clef 86.5 → \to 23.9%, Cygnet 93.9 → \to 15.7%), and on TextWorld to between 35% and 42% (from 74–86%). The other systems that answer ALFWorld decisions fall into the same band on the distance ladder (OpenAI Decisions 83.1 → \to 14.8%, Eikos-27B 88.6 → \to 15.3%, Perplexity Decider-27B 86.9 → \to 22.1%, Vega-27B 86.0 → \to 22.2%, Decider-chat-31B 93.6 → \to 24.3%; SimpleJev-27B and Torchcast-27B, weaker to begin with, 45.1 → \to 6.8% and 59.1 → \to 7.7%) and to 30–48% on TextWorld, while on BabyAI they lose at most 2.3 points or improve. The models therefore do read the trace, and the facts-right, action-wrong errors of § 5 are not a sign that the history is ignored.
paragraphs.zh: 移除执行历史后，BabyAI 几乎保持不变（JEV 73.3 → \to 70.1%；Gemma 甚至从 75.5% 上升到 79.9%），因为当前视图在很大程度上决定了下一步行动，但这一操作会合并那些需要记住早期观察结果的状态（图 10a）。 在 ALFWorld 距离阶梯上，所有强大系统的得分都降至 14% 到 24% 之间（JEV 87.2 → \to 13.7%，Gemma 92.6 → \to 22.6%，Clef 86.5 → \to 23.9%，Cygnet 93.9 → \to 15.7%）；在 TextWorld 上，则降至 35% 到 42% 之间（从 74–86%）。 其他回答 ALFWorld 决策的系统在距离阶梯上也落入相同的区间（OpenAI Decisions 83.1 → \to 14.8%，Eikos-27B 88.6 → \to 15.3%，Perplexity Decider-27B 86.9 → \to 22.1%，Vega-27B 86.0 → \to 22.2%，Decider-chat-31B 93.6 → \to 24.3%；而原本较弱的 SimpleJev-27B 和 Torchcast-27B，得分从 45.1 → \to 6.8% 和 59.1 → \to 7.7%）；在 TextWorld 上，它们的得分降至 30–48%，而在 BabyAI 上，它们最多仅损失 2.3 分或有所提升。 因此，这些模型确实会读取执行轨迹，而 §5 中提到的“事实正确、行动错误”类错误并非表明历史被忽略。

paragraphs.en: The ALFWorld ladders locate where accuracy begins to fall (Figure 10 b). When the needed object has already been seen, Clef and Gemma stay within about ten points of their short-trace accuracy up to 23 steps, while JEV falls from 0.89 for three or fewer steps to 0.68–0.78 beyond. The larger effect is in states that still require exploration: JEV drops from 0.72 to 0.48 once the trace exceeds seven steps and Clef from 0.91 to 0.55, while Gemma stays between 0.72 and 0.82. Keeping track of which places have already been searched is the hard part. The distance between the decisive observation and the decision, in contrast, has no effect over the range we test: from zero to 15 irrelevant intervening steps, no competent system loses more than three points (e.g. Gemma 0.92–0.94, JEV 0.84–0.90). The other systems agree: all lose accuracy on long traces (OpenAI Decisions even when the object has been seen, 0.81 to 0.61), and none loses accuracy with distance; Torchcast-27B even gains (0.52 with no intervening step, 0.64 with 15).
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld 的阶梯模型定位了准确率开始下降的位置（图 10b）。 当所需物体已被看到时，Clef 和 Gemma 在最多 23 步内，其短轨迹准确率保持在约十个百分点以内，而 JEV 则从 0.89 降至三步或更少时的 0.68–0.78。 更大的影响出现在仍需探索的状态中：一旦轨迹超过七步，JEV 会从 0.72 降至 0.48，Clef 会从 0.91 降至 0.55，而 Gemma 则保持在 0.72 到 0.82 之间。 追踪哪些地方已经被搜索过是其中的难点。 相比之下，决定性观察与决策之间的距离在我们测试的范围内没有影响：从零到 15 个无关的中间步骤，没有任何一个合格系统的准确率下降超过三个百分点（例如： Gemma 为 0.92–0.94，JEV 为 0.84–0.90）。 其他系统也表现出一致的趋势：所有系统在长轨迹下都会损失准确率（即使物体已被看到，OpenAI Decisions 的准确率也会从 0.81 降至 0.61），但没有一个系统会因距离而损失准确率；Torchcast-27B 甚至有所提升（无中间步骤时为 0.52，有 15 步中间步骤时为 0.64）。

paragraphs.en: When a single observation is edited so that the gold action changes (Figure 10 c), Cygnet, Clef and Gemma change their decision in 91–96% of ALFWorld triples, Qwen3.8-27B in 79% and JEV in 71%, while all keep their decision after an irrelevant edit in 89–97% of cases. Decider-chat-31B (91%) and Eikos-27B (84%) react about as often as Cygnet, Clef and Gemma, and OpenAI Decisions is the least stable, changing after 64% of relevant edits but also after 20% of irrelevant ones; Torchcast-27B changes its decision after only 59% of relevant edits. Customer-service policy edits are a sharper case of the dissociation. When one record field is edited so that the policy now requires a different tool call, JEV, Clef, Gemma and Qwen3.8-27B answer every probe on the edited state correctly (all 374 edited states), yet in the 83 matched triples they change the call after a relevant edit in only 22% (Clef) to 57% (Qwen3.8-27B) of cases. The models read the edited fact and still act as if it had not changed. OpenAI Decisions answers 99.5% of the edited states’ probes correctly and changes the call in 41%; Torchcast-27B answers all of them correctly and changes the call in 40%. Eikos-27B is the exception: with every probe right, it changes the call after 72% of relevant edits and never after an irrelevant one. Decider-chat-31B never selects the required tool call on these states, so the question does not arise for it.
paragraphs.zh: 当单个观察结果被编辑，导致黄金动作发生变化时（图 10c），Cygnet、Clef 和 Gemma 在 91–96% 的 ALFWorld 三元组中改变了决策，Qwen3.8-27B 为 79%，JEV 为 71%；而在无关编辑的情况下，所有模型在 89–97% 的案例中都保持了原有决策。 Decider-chat-31B（91%）和 Eikos-27B（84%）的反应频率与 Cygnet、Clef 和 Gemma 大致相当，而 OpenAI Decisions 的稳定性最差：在 64% 的相关编辑后改变了决策，但在 20% 的无关编辑后也发生了改变；Torchcast-27B 仅在 59% 的相关编辑后改变了决策。 客户服务策略的编辑是这种解耦现象的一个更明显的例子。 当某个记录字段被编辑，导致策略现在要求不同的工具调用时，JEV、Clef、Gemma 和 Qwen3.8-27B 对编辑后状态的所有查询都给出了正确回答（共 374 个编辑状态）；但在 83 个匹配的三元组中，它们仅在 22%（Clef）到 57%（Qwen3.8-27B）的相关编辑案例中改变了工具调用。 这些模型读取了被编辑的事实，但仍然表现得仿佛该事实并未改变。 OpenAI Decisions 对 99.5% 的编辑状态查询给出了正确回答，并在 41% 的案例中改变了工具调用；Torchcast-27B 对所有查询都给出了正确回答，但在 40% 的案例中改变了工具调用。 Eikos-27B 是例外：它在所有查询中都回答正确，但在 72% 的相关编辑后改变了工具调用，且从未在无关编辑后改变。 Decider-chat-31B 在这些状态下从未选择所需的工具调用，因此这个问题对它而言并不存在。

paragraphs.en: When a TextWorld game states that cooking rules differ from the usual ones, the strong systems follow the stated rules in 90–99% of states (Clef 99.3%, Qwen3.8-27B 96.3%, JEV 93.3%, Gemma 90.3%), with the same results on a cohort generated later from new seeds. Kev-9B reaches 83.0% on the same states without ever answering all the rule probes correctly, an example of a correct action that does not follow from the measured facts. The other System One models follow the stated rules in 89–100% of states in both cohorts, with every rule probe answered correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 当 TextWorld 游戏说明烹饪规则与常规规则不同时，强大的智能体在 90–99% 的状态下都会遵循所陈述的规则（Clef 99.3%，Qwen3.8-27B 96.3%，JEV 93.3%，Gemma 90.3%），并且在之后使用新种子生成的数据组中也得到了相同的结果。 Kev-9B 在同一状态下达到了 83.0% 的准确率，但从未在所有规则探测中全部答对，这体现了正确行动并不必然源于所测得的事实。 其他 System One 模型在两个数据组中均有 89–100% 的状态遵循了所陈述的规则，且所有规则探测均回答正确。

paragraphs.en: Because System One models return a distribution, their confidence could decide when to escalate. Figure 11 shows that calibration varies far more across systems than accuracy does. Cygnet, whose recipe includes a calibration step, has an expected calibration error of 2.6%, and JEV 6.8%. Clef and Kev-9B are underconfident (mean confidence 0.66 and 0.47 at accuracies of 0.76 and 0.62), while the likelihood readout of Gemma is almost always near-certain (mean confidence 0.98 at an accuracy of 0.79; ECE 19.1%). For JEV, confidence is informative enough to drive the cascade of § 6.1 , but for an uncalibrated readout the same threshold would rarely fire. OpenAI Decisions, Eikos-27B and Decider-chat-31B are underconfident like Clef (mean confidence about 0.66 at accuracies of 0.70–0.79; ECE 8.8–11.9%), and Perplexity Decider-27B is close to Qwen3.8-27B (8.2%). Torchcast-27B is about as well calibrated as JEV (ECE 7.2%; mean confidence 0.70 at an accuracy of 0.69). OpenAI Decisions’ own confidence field, which we do not use, is lower still (ECE 13.9%). Quyet-1.0-Large’s low error (6.0%) covers only the 21% of decisions it answers. Apart from CLM-8B and Laya, Vega-27B is the least calibrated system we measure (ECE 26.6%): its mean confidence of 0.51 at an accuracy of 0.78 makes it strongly underconfident.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 System One 模型返回的是分布，其置信度可以决定何时升级处理。 图 11 显示，不同系统之间的校准程度差异远大于准确率差异。 Cygnet 的构建流程包含校准步骤，其预期校准误差为 2.6%，而 JEV 为 6.8%。 Clef 和 Kev-9B 存在置信度不足的问题（在准确率为 0.76 和 0.62 时，平均置信度分别为 0.66 和 0.47），而 Gemma 的可能性输出几乎总是接近完全确定（在准确率为 0.79 时，平均置信度为 0.98；ECE 为 19.1%）。 对于 JEV，其置信度足以驱动 §6.1 中的级联处理，但对于未经校准的输出，相同的阈值几乎不会触发。 OpenAI Decisions、Eikos-27B 和 Decider-chat-31B 与 Clef 一样存在置信度不足的问题（在准确率为 0.70–0.79 时，平均置信度约为 0.66；ECE 为 8.8–11.9%），而 Perplexity Decider-27B 的表现接近 Qwen3.8-27B（8.2%）。 Torchcast-27B 的校准效果与 JEV 大致相当（ECE 为 7.2%；在准确率为 0.69 时，平均置信度为 0.70）。 OpenAI Decisions 自身的置信度字段（我们并未使用）甚至更低（ECE 为 13.9%）。 Quyet-1.0-Large 的低误差率（6.0%）仅覆盖其回答的决策中 21% 的情况。 除了 CLM-8B 和 Laya，Vega-27B 是我们测得校准效果最差的系统（ECE 为 26.6%）：在准确率为 0.78 时，其平均置信度仅为 0.51，表明其存在严重的置信度不足问题。

paragraphs.en: Scoring a supplied set of answers, long used in classification and reranking, is now offered as a programmable interface for agents, by hosted models ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026a ; Liquid AI, 2026 ) and open alternatives ( Kwok et al., 2026 ; Palmer, 2026 ; Cloudflare, 2026 ; Convai Innovations, 2026 ; Vicentino, 2026 ; Perplexity AI, 2026 ; SimpleJev, 2026 ; vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026 ; Nguyen, 2026 ; Blockbrain Labs, 2026 ; Mapika, 2026 ) . As an evaluation judge, JEV approaches a reasoning judge where a verdict can be read off the text but falls behind where it must be derived, and its confidence can decide when to escalate ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Public comparisons report aggregate scores ( Apolinário, 2026 ) ; agent benchmarks measure task success, progress or per-step correctness ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2023 ) , and fixed histories with a next-action question are established ( George et al., 2024 ) . We ask what such accuracy leaves unexplained, pairing each decision with probes on the same state.
paragraphs.zh: 长期以来用于分类和重排序的给定答案集评分功能，如今已由托管模型（TypeSafe AI, 2026；OpenAI, 2026a；Liquid AI, 2026）和开放替代方案（Kwok et al., 2026；Palmer, 2026；Cloudflare, 2026；Convai Innovations, 2026；Vicentino, 2026；Perplexity AI, 2026；SimpleJev, 2026；vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026；Nguyen, 2026；Blockbrain Labs, 2026；Mapika, 2026）为智能体提供了可编程接口。 作为评估裁判，JEV接近于推理裁判：在裁决可从文本中直接读出的情况下表现良好，但在必须推导出裁决时则相形见绌，且其置信度可以决定何时升级处理（Li et al., 2026）。 公开比较报告提供了汇总分数（Apolinário, 2026）；智能体基准测试衡量任务成功、进展或每一步的正确性（Shridhar et al., 2021；Ma et al., 2024；Barres et al., 2026；Deng et al., 2023），并建立了带有“下一步行动”问题的固定历史记录（George et al., 2024）。 我们探讨这种准确性未能解释的问题，并将每个决策与对同一状态的探测相结合进行分析。

sents.en: As an evaluation judge, JEV approaches a reasoning judge where a verdict can be read off the text but falls behind where it must be derived, and its confidence can decide when to escalate ( Li et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: Public comparisons report aggregate scores ( Apolinário, 2026 ) ; agent benchmarks measure task success, progress or per-step correctness ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2023 ) , and fixed histories with a next-action question are established ( George et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 公开比较报告提供了汇总分数（Apolinário, 2026）；智能体基准测试衡量任务成功、进展或每一步的正确性（Shridhar et al., 2021；Ma et al., 2024；Barres et al., 2026；Deng et al., 2023），并建立了带有“下一步行动”问题的固定历史记录（George et al., 2024）。

sents.en: We ask what such accuracy leaves unexplained, pairing each decision with probes on the same state.
sents.zh: 我们探讨这种准确性未能解释的问题，并将每个决策与对同一状态的探测相结合进行分析。

paragraphs.en: Studies of agents ( Schmied et al., 2026 ; Sobotka et al., 2026 ; Deb and Krishnan, 2026 ; Arghal et al., 2026 ) separate what an agent appears to know from what it does. Language models are also distracted by irrelevant context ( Shi et al., 2023 ) , plan better with an external component ( Valmeekam et al., 2023 ; Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) , and answer every sub-question of a problem yet fail the composed question ( Press et al., 2023 ) . Our setting exposes neither text nor hidden states, the probes are answered in isolation on the exact state, and we test whether the probe set can support the diagnosis at all. The remedies we test mirror decomposed and program-aided reasoning ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Khot et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) , but the sub-questions go to the same choice-only model and the composition is done by the calling program.
paragraphs.zh: 对智能体的研究（Schmied 等，2026；Sobotka 等，2026；Deb 和 Krishnan，2026；Arghal 等，2026）将智能体看似所知道的内容与其实际行为区分开来。 语言模型也会受到无关上下文的影响（Shi 等，2023），借助外部组件能更好地进行规划（Valmeekam 等，2023；Kambhampati 等，2024），并且能够回答问题的每一个子问题，却无法正确回答组合后的问题（Press 等，2023）。 我们的设置既不提供文本也不提供隐藏状态，探针的回答基于确切状态独立进行，我们测试的是该探针集是否完全支持诊断。 我们所测试的解决方案类似于分解式与程序辅助推理（Zhou 等，2023；Khot 等，2023；Gao 等，2023），但子问题仍由同一个仅支持选择的模型处理，而组合则由调用程序完成。

Like behavioral testing ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) , and unlike probing classifiers ( Belinkov, 2022 ) , we infer competence from controlled questions and input variations. paragraphs.en: The results suggest a simple procedure for deploying a System One model in an agent loop. First, measure the paired outcomes on the target states. If most errors follow misread facts, the remedy lies in the state representation, the trace format or the context budget. If most follow correct reading, as for every strong system here, the next question is whether the decision-relevant facts are known and the rules explicit. Where they are, as on our generated procedures, the strongest remedy is to ask the facts as narrow parallel questions and compose the action in code, which brought every system we tried to 0.96–1.00 at the price of a second batch of cheap questions; a confidence cascade keeps most of the gain with a second request on a third of the states. Where the decision requires choosing a sub-goal in an open task, as in ALFWorld, appending facts helps little, and the missing ingredient is a sub-goal that the model does not reliably supply; that is a planning problem, for a planner, for training, or for a deliberating model on the few states that need it.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，在智能体循环中部署“系统一”模型可以采用一种简单的方法。 首先，测量目标状态下的成对结果。 如果大多数错误源于事实误读，那么解决方案应着眼于状态表示、追踪格式或上下文预算。 如果大多数错误源于正确的事实读取（此处所有强大系统均如此），那么下一个问题就是：与决策相关的事实是否已知，规则是否明确。 在这些情况下（如我们生成的流程所示），最有效的解决方案是将事实作为狭窄的并行问题提出，并用代码组合行动；这一方法使我们测试的所有系统的性能都达到了 0.96–1.00，代价是第二轮廉价的问题；而通过信心级联机制，仅对三分之一的状态进行第二次询问，即可保留大部分性能提升。 如果决策需要在开放任务中选择子目标（如 ALFWorld 中的情况），那么附加事实的帮助有限，缺失的关键要素是一个模型无法稳定提供的子目标；这属于规划问题，需要借助规划器、训练过程，或是在少数需要规划的状态上由模型进行审慎推理来解决。

paragraphs.en: The pooled accuracies of Table 2 hide most of what matters. Rankings change across domains (Figure 4 ); a perfect action score on coding traces hides a twelve-point difference in reading; two systems with similar paired accuracy fail for different reasons (consolidation for JEV, cue capture for Clef); and the most accurate fast system, Gemma’s likelihood readout, is among the least calibrated. Fast decision models are therefore better evaluated with diagnostic panels and their controls, and with freshly generated states whose probes are sufficient by construction, that match the kind of state a workflow depends on, than with a single number.
paragraphs.zh: 表2中的汇总准确率掩盖了大多数关键信息。 排名在不同领域中存在差异（图4）；在编码轨迹上获得完美动作得分，可能掩盖了阅读能力上12分的差距；两个配对准确率相近的系统却因不同原因而失效（JEV因整合问题，Clef因线索捕捉问题）；此外，最准确且运行最快的系统——Gemma的似然输出——其校准效果反而最差。 因此，评估快速决策模型时，与其依赖单一数值，不如使用诊断面板及其对照测试，以及通过设计确保探测充分、与工作流程所依赖的状态类型相匹配的全新生成状态。

paragraphs.en: GPT-6.1 shows what deliberation buys on the same states: seven to twelve points of decision accuracy at roughly seventy times the cost of JEV. It does not change the kind of error that remains. For agent builders, the interesting design space is therefore not System One versus reasoning models, but which states a fast model can be trusted on, which need a composed decision, and which need deliberation. The paired measurement, the probe-sufficiency check and the model’s own calibration are the instruments for drawing that line.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-6.1 展示了在相同状态下，深思熟虑能带来怎样的提升：决策准确率提高七到十二个百分点，而成本仅为 JEV 的约七十倍。 它并未改变所遗留错误的具体类型。 因此，对于智能体构建者而言，真正值得关注的设计空间并非“系统一”与推理模型之间的对比，而是需要明确：哪些状态可以信赖快速模型处理，哪些需要审慎决策，以及哪些需要进行深思熟虑。 配对测量方法——探测充分性检查与模型自身的校准——正是划定这一界限的工具。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral evidence only. The paired outcomes are observations on identical inputs. They do not show which internal computation produced an action, and a correct probe answer does not prove that the model used that fact. Probe coverage. On natural states the probes are not sufficient for the decision, so a facts-right, action-wrong outcome mixes decision failures with facts we did not ask about; the generated ladder and the decision-oriented probes address this only for the domains they cover. Labels. Gold actions are computed from agent-observable information, but they can be stricter than necessary (5–42% of a system’s simulator errors are in fact optimal) and, in the original ALFWorld cohorts, co-located receptacles produce wrong location labels for 303 of 8,197 paired ALFWorld records; we keep the frozen labels and report sensitivity analyses. Deployments, not architectures. Systems differ in serving stack, readout and input limits, two author runtimes shorten long states themselves, and hosted models can change between versions (96.3% agreement on a JEV rerun after five days; OpenAI Decisions is a public beta). Scope. We evaluate single decisions on frozen traces, not closed-loop execution, and the follow-up studies of § 6 cover a subset of systems: the composition ladder and probe-then-decide sixteen each, and the decision-oriented probes twelve (each count includes the reasoning reference). The reasoning reference answered each question in a separate call with a verbalized distribution, so its calibration is not comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 仅有行为证据。 成对结果是对相同输入的观测。 它们并未显示哪项内部计算产生了某个动作，且正确的探针答案也无法证明模型确实使用了该事实。探针覆盖范围。 在自然状态下，探针不足以支持决策，因此“事实正确、动作错误”的结果会将决策失败与我们未询问的事实混为一谈；生成的阶梯和面向决策的探针仅在其覆盖的领域内解决了这一问题。标签。 黄金动作是根据智能体可观测信息计算得出的，但它们可能比必要情况更为严格（系统模拟器中 5%–42% 的错误实际上属于最优选择），并且在最初的 ALFWorld 数据集中，位置相同的容器导致 8,197 条成对 ALFWorld 记录中有 303 条的位置标签错误；我们保留这些固定的标签，并报告了敏感性分析。 部署而非架构。 系统在服务栈、读取和输入限制方面存在差异，两位作者的运行时本身会缩短长状态，且托管模型可能在不同版本间切换（在五天后的 JEV 重新运行中一致性为 96.3%；OpenAI Decisions 处于公开测试阶段）。范围。 我们在固定轨迹上评估单次决策，而非闭环执行，并且 § 6 的后续研究仅涵盖部分系统：组合阶梯和“先探针后决策”各包含十六个系统，而面向决策的探针则包含十二个（每个计数均包含推理参考）。 推理参考通过单独调用回答每个问题，并以语言形式表述了分布，因此其校准结果不具备可比性。
