paragraphs.en: A fast decision model that errs leaves nothing behind but a wrong action. By asking the same model, on the same state, what it read and what it chose, we find that for strong systems the problem is usually not reading. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, most wrong actions follow correct reading, and they gather on states that defeat systems of every kind. Reading right and acting wrong is therefore not the mark of weak models but the characteristic failure of strong ones. Nor is it a single failure. When the decisive facts are known, models fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the decision; in open tasks they lack the next sub-goal, which additional facts do not supply. Both point to one way of building agents on fast models: let the model read, through many narrow questions, and hand the composition of the decision to code, to a planner, or to deliberation where a state requires it. Measuring reading and acting separately is what tells which a state requires.
paragraphs.zh: 一个快速决策模型一旦出错，只会留下错误的行动。 通过向同一模型在相同状态下询问它读取了什么以及选择了什么，我们发现对于强大的系统而言，问题通常不在于读取。 在十七个快速系统和一个推理模型中，大多数错误行动都发生在正确读取之后，并且它们集中在那些会击败各类系统的状态上。 因此，读取正确而行动错误并非弱模型的标志，而是强模型典型的失败特征。 而且这并非单一的一次性失败。 当决定性事实已知时，模型无法将它们组合起来，而由代码构成的自身答案也无法修正决策；在开放任务中，它们缺乏下一个子目标，而额外的事实也无法提供这个目标。 这两点都指向了基于快速模型构建智能体的一种方法：让模型通过许多具体的问题逐步读取信息，然后将决策的组合交由代码、规划器或根据状态需要交由审慎推理来完成。 分别测量读取和行动，正是判断某一状态需要哪种方法的关键。

sents.en: A fast decision model that errs leaves nothing behind but a wrong action.
sents.zh: 一个快速决策模型一旦出错，只会留下错误的行动。

sents.en: By asking the same model, on the same state, what it read and what it chose, we find that for strong systems the problem is usually not reading.
sents.zh: 通过向同一模型在相同状态下询问它读取了什么以及选择了什么，我们发现对于强大的系统而言，问题通常不在于读取。

sents.en: Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, most wrong actions follow correct reading, and they gather on states that defeat systems of every kind.
sents.zh: 在十七个快速系统和一个推理模型中，大多数错误行动都发生在正确读取之后，并且它们集中在那些会击败各类系统的状态上。

sents.en: Reading right and acting wrong is therefore not the mark of weak models but the characteristic failure of strong ones.
sents.zh: 因此，读取正确而行动错误并非弱模型的标志，而是强模型典型的失败特征。

sents.en: Nor is it a single failure.
sents.zh: 而且这并非单一的一次性失败。

sents.en: When the decisive facts are known, models fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the decision; in open tasks they lack the next sub-goal, which additional facts do not supply.
sents.zh: 当决定性事实已知时，模型无法将它们组合起来，而由代码构成的自身答案也无法修正决策；在开放任务中，它们缺乏下一个子目标，而额外的事实也无法提供这个目标。

sents.en: Both point to one way of building agents on fast models: let the model read, through many narrow questions, and hand the composition of the decision to code, to a planner, or to deliberation where a state requires it.
sents.zh: 这两点都指向了基于快速模型构建智能体的一种方法：让模型通过许多具体的问题逐步读取信息，然后将决策的组合交由代码、规划器或根据状态需要交由审慎推理来完成。

sents.en: Measuring reading and acting separately is what tells which a state requires.
sents.zh: 分别测量读取和行动，正是判断某一状态需要哪种方法的关键。

paragraphs.en: Most language agents generate reasoning and actions token by token ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2022 ) . System One models instead score a supplied set of answers and return a distribution over them, a pattern long used in classification and reranking that is now offered as a general programmable interface for agents and software. Examples include hosted models such as JEV ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) , OpenAI’s Decisions API ( OpenAI, 2026a ) and Liquid’s decision models ( Liquid AI, 2026 ) , and open alternatives that range from a two-tower head over frozen embeddings ( Kwok et al., 2026 ) to fine-tuned pointer and schema heads ( Palmer, 2026 ; Cloudflare, 2026 ) , a compact encoder ( Convai Innovations, 2026 ) , fine-tuned 27–31B decision models ( Vicentino, 2026 ; Perplexity AI, 2026 ; SimpleJev, 2026 ; vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026 ; Nguyen, 2026 ) , and recipes that read a frozen open-weight model through the same interface ( Blockbrain Labs, 2026 ; Mapika, 2026 ) . Public comparisons of these systems report aggregate scores on decision suites ( Apolinário, 2026 ) . We instead ask what such accuracy leaves unexplained: whether errors reflect misreading or mis-deciding, and how far that question can be answered through a choice-only interface. The “System 1” label borrows the fast/deliberate distinction of Kahneman (2011) ; we use it, as these models’ developers do, only to name the interface, not to claim anything about the computation inside the models. Their output types go beyond choices; we evaluate only the choice interface.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数语言智能体以逐词符的方式生成推理和动作（Yao 等，2023；Wei 等，2022）。 相比之下，“系统一”模型会对一组提供的答案进行评分，并返回一个分布结果。这种模式长期以来被用于分类和重排序，如今则作为智能体和软件通用的可编程接口提供。 示例包括托管模型，如 JEV（TypeSafe AI，2026）、OpenAI 的 Decisions API（OpenAI，2026a）以及 Liquid 的决策模型（Liquid AI，2026）；还有开源替代方案，涵盖从基于冻结嵌入的双塔结构（Kwok 等，2026），到经过微调的指针和模式头（Palmer，2026；Cloudflare，2026）、紧凑型编码器（Convai Innovations，2026）、经过微调的 27–31B 决策模型（Vicentino，2026；Perplexity AI，2026；SimpleJev，2026；vLLM Semantic Router Team，2026；Nguyen，2026），以及通过相同接口读取冻结开放权重模型的方案（Blockbrain Labs，2026；Mapika，2026）。 这些系统的公开对比报告了它们在决策套件上的综合得分（Apolinário，2026）。 我们则转而探讨这种准确性未能解释的问题：错误究竟源于误读还是决策失误？这一问题又能在多大程度上通过仅支持选择的接口得到解答？ “系统一”这一标签借鉴了 Kahneman（2011）提出的快速/审慎区分；我们像这些模型的开发者一样，仅用该名称来指代接口，而非对模型内部的计算过程做出任何断言。 它们的输出类型不仅限于选择；我们仅评估其选择接口。

paragraphs.en: Interactive environments such as ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , BabyAI ( Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ; Paglieri et al., 2025 ) and TextWorld ( Côté et al., 2018 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) , and suites such as AgentBoard ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2026 ) and Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , mainly measure task success, progress or per-step action correctness. Tool-use benchmarks test tool selection, argument filling and when to call a tool ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Ross et al., 2025 ) , and large synthesized tool-use trajectories are available for training ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and trajectory-judgment benchmarks test whether a model can tell success, safety or the failing step from a finished trace ( Lù et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Presenting a fixed agent history and asking for the next action is itself established ( George et al., 2024 ) ; AgentRM-style trees provide sibling actions with value estimates ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . We reuse many of these sources, but we pair each decision with independently answered factual probes on the same state, place every admissible action in context, and compute gold labels only from information visible to the agent. Label errors in test sets can change benchmark conclusions ( Northcutt et al., 2021 ) ; re-deriving labels from the agent-visible text, as we do in § 5.4 , is one way to find them when a simulator’s internal state and the text disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式环境，如 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等，2021）、BabyAI（Chevalier-Boisvert 等，2019；Paglieri 等，2025）和 TextWorld（Côté 等，2018；Cui 等，2025），以及工具包，如 AgentBoard（Ma 等，2024）、τ \tau -bench（Yao 等，2025；Barres 等，2026）和 Mind2Web（Deng 等，2023），主要衡量任务成功、进展或每一步动作的正确性。 工具使用基准测试工具的选择、参数填充以及何时调用工具（Patil 等，2025；Shi 等，2025；Ross 等，2025），并且已有大量合成的工具使用轨迹可供训练（Xu 等，2026）；而轨迹判断基准测试则检验模型能否根据完整的轨迹判断成功、安全或失败步骤（Lù 等，2025；Yuan 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025）。 提供固定的智能体历史并询问下一步动作的做法本身已有定论（George 等，2024）；AgentRM 风格的树结构则通过提供带有价值估计的兄弟动作来辅助决策（Xia 等，2025）。 我们重用了许多这些资源，但将每个决策与针对同一状态的独立事实性探针问题相结合，将所有可行的动作置于上下文中，并且仅根据智能体可见的信息计算标准标签。 测试集中的标签错误可能会改变基准测试的结论（Northcutt 等，2021）；像我们在 §5.4 中那样，从智能体可见的文本中重新推导标签，是在模拟器内部状态与文本不一致时发现标签错误的一种方法。

paragraphs.en: Several recent studies separate what an agent appears to know from what it does. Sobotka et al. (2026) distinguish observation–belief from belief–action gaps and intervene on beliefs through steering and prompting. Deb and Krishnan (2026) measure state judgments and control separately in a supply-chain task, Arghal et al. (2026) combine behavior, optimal policies and representation probes in grid worlds, and Schmied et al. (2026) report a knowing–doing gap in which models can state a good strategy but do not act on it. State-maintenance methods for long-horizon agents decide when to compress, retrieve or rewrite history ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Our setting differs in three ways that follow from the interface we study. The models expose neither text nor hidden states, so all evidence is behavioral; the probes are answered in isolation on the exact decision state rather than elicited as free-text rationales; and we test whether the probe set is sufficient to support the diagnosis at all. At the scale of a full benchmark, we find the knowing–doing gap to be the dominant source of error for every strong system, including a reasoning model, and we show that it is not one phenomenon: depending on system and state, it reflects a failure to combine facts, capture by irrelevant cues, or the choice of the next sub-goal.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的多项研究将智能体看似所知道的内容与其实际行为区分开来。Sobotka 等人 （2026）区分了观察–信念与信念–行动之间的差距，并通过引导和提示对信念进行干预。 Deb 和 Krishnan（2026）在供应链任务中分别测量了状态判断与控制；Arghal 等人 （2026）在网格世界中结合了行为、最优策略和表征探测；而 Schmied 等人 （2026）报告了一种“知–行”差距：模型能够陈述良好策略，却并未据此行动。 针对长期规划智能体的状态维护方法会决定何时压缩、检索或重写历史（Wang 等人，2026b；Wang 等人，2026a）。 我们所研究的环境在三个方面有所不同，这些差异源于我们研究的接口。 模型既不提供文本也不暴露隐藏状态，因此所有证据均来自行为；探测问题是在特定决策状态下独立回答的，而非以自由文本形式解释理由；此外，我们还检验了探测集是否足以支持诊断本身。 在完整基准测试的规模下，我们发现“知–行”差距是每一个强大系统（包括推理模型）的主要错误来源，并且我们证明这并非单一现象：根据系统和状态的不同，它可能反映了对事实整合的失败、被无关线索所误导，或是下一子目标的选择问题。

paragraphs.en: Language models often answer every sub-question of a multi-step problem yet fail the composed question, a compositionality gap that does not shrink with model size, because single-step accuracy improves faster than composed accuracy ( Press et al., 2023 ) . They are also distracted by irrelevant context ( Shi et al., 2023 ) and use evidence unevenly across long inputs ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Our composition ladder (§ 6.1 ) is a controlled version of this question for agent decisions: with probes that provably determine the action, we can attribute a facts-right, action-wrong outcome to composition, and the rewrites separate consolidation of scattered evidence from capture by irrelevant cues. The remedies we test mirror known ones. Answering sub-questions first and then deciding resembles least-to-most and decomposed prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Khot et al., 2023 ) , and composing the action in code resembles program-aided reasoning ( Gao et al., 2023 ) . The difference is the setting: the sub-questions are asked of the same choice-only model in parallel, without generated text, and the composition is done by the calling program, as System One models are designed to be used ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型通常会回答多步问题中的每一个子问题，却可能无法正确回答组合而成的最终问题。这种“组合性鸿沟”并不会随着模型规模的增大而缩小，因为单步推理的准确率提升速度比组合推理的准确率更快（Press 等，2023）。 它们还会被无关的上下文干扰（Shi 等，2023），并且在处理长输入时不均匀地使用证据（Liu 等，2024）。 我们的组合阶梯（§6.1）是这一问题在智能体决策场景下的受控版本：通过能够明确决定行动的探针，我们可以将“事实正确但行动错误”的结果归因于组合过程；而重写机制则将分散证据的整合与无关线索的干扰区分开来。 我们测试的解决方案均与已知的方法类似。 先回答子问题再做出决策的方式类似于“从少到多”和分解式提示方法（Zhou 等，2023；Khot 等，2023）；而在代码中组合行动的方式则类似于程序辅助推理（Gao 等，2023）。 不同之处在于设置方式：子问题由同一个仅支持选择的模型并行回答，且没有生成文本；组合过程则由调用程序完成，这正是 System One 模型的设计用途（TypeSafe AI，2026）。

sents.en: Language models often answer every sub-question of a multi-step problem yet fail the composed question, a compositionality gap that does not shrink with model size, because single-step accuracy improves faster than composed accuracy ( Press et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 语言模型通常会回答多步问题中的每一个子问题，却可能无法正确回答组合而成的最终问题。这种“组合性鸿沟”并不会随着模型规模的增大而缩小，因为单步推理的准确率提升速度比组合推理的准确率更快（Press 等，2023）。

sents.en: They are also distracted by irrelevant context ( Shi et al., 2023 ) and use evidence unevenly across long inputs ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 它们还会被无关的上下文干扰（Shi 等，2023），并且在处理长输入时不均匀地使用证据（Liu 等，2024）。

sents.en: Our composition ladder (§ 6.1 ) is a controlled version of this question for agent decisions: with probes that provably determine the action, we can attribute a facts-right, action-wrong outcome to composition, and the rewrites separate consolidation of scattered evidence from capture by irrelevant cues.
sents.zh: 我们的组合阶梯（§6.1）是这一问题在智能体决策场景下的受控版本：通过能够明确决定行动的探针，我们可以将“事实正确但行动错误”的结果归因于组合过程；而重写机制则将分散证据的整合与无关线索的干扰区分开来。

sents.en: The remedies we test mirror known ones.
sents.zh: 我们测试的解决方案均与已知的方法类似。

paragraphs.en: Language models are weak autonomous planners, and planning works better when a model proposes and an external component checks or plans ( Valmeekam et al., 2023 ; Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) . On real ALFWorld states we find a matching pattern for a System One model: JEV reads the state almost perfectly, but stating the next sub-goal adds 16 points that no amount of additional facts provides (§ 6.3 ). This suggests a division of labor in which the fast model reads and acts, and the sub-goal comes from a planner or a deliberating model.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型是较弱的自主规划者，当模型提出计划而外部组件进行验证或规划时，规划效果会更好（Valmeekam 等，2023；Kambhampati 等，2024）。 在真实的 ALFWorld 状态中，我们发现系统一模型存在一种匹配模式：JEV 几乎能完美读取状态，但陈述下一个子目标会额外增加 16 分，而任何数量的附加事实都无法提供这些分数（§6.3）。 这表明存在一种分工：快速模型负责读取和执行，而子目标则由规划器或审慎推理的模型提供。

paragraphs.en: Cascades that send only uncertain inputs to a more expensive model reduce cost at little loss in accuracy ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , provided the score that decides whether to accept the cheap answer is informative. The same idea has been applied to evaluation with a System One model: JEV used as a judge accepts its confident verdicts and escalates the rest to a reasoning judge ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Our confidence cascade (§ 6.1 ) applies this idea within one System One model, and our calibration results (§ 7 ) show that whether it can work depends strongly on the readout.
paragraphs.zh: 级联处理中，若仅将不确定的输入送入更昂贵的模型，则可在几乎不损失准确性的情况下降低成本（Chen 等人，2024），前提是决定是否接受廉价答案的评分具有信息价值。 同样的思路也已被应用于使用系统一模型进行的评估：作为评判者的 JEV 会接受其自信的判定结果，并将其余情况转交给推理型评判者处理（Li 等人，2026）。 我们的置信度级联方法（§6.1）将这一思路应用到了单一的系统一模型内部，而我们的校准结果（§7）表明，该方法能否有效运行在很大程度上取决于读出的结果。

paragraphs.en: Automated failure attribution asks which agent or step caused the failure of a single- or multi-agent system ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and recent work stresses that an error can admit several valid explanations ( In et al., 2026 ) . Our target is narrower and lower in the stack: for a single decision, was the available evidence read correctly? Generated explanations are an unreliable route to this answer, because chains of thought need not be faithful to the computation that produced an answer ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Lanham et al., 2023 ) . Our method is closer to behavioral testing ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ) : we infer competence from controlled questions and input variations, and, unlike probing classifiers ( Belinkov, 2022 ) , we need no access to internal representations. Finally, because System One models expose probabilities, we also ask whether their confidence flags risky decisions ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自动化故障归因旨在确定单个或多智能体系统中导致故障的智能体或步骤（Zhang 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2026），而近期的研究强调，一个错误可能对应多种合理的解释（In 等人，2026）。 我们的目标更具体且位于系统堆栈的较低层级：对于单个决策，可用的证据是否被正确读取？ 生成的解释并非获得这一答案的可靠途径，因为思维链未必忠实于生成答案的实际计算过程（Turpin 等人，2023；Lanham 等人，2023）。 我们的方法更接近行为测试（Ribeiro 等人，2020）：我们通过受控的问题和输入变化来推断能力，并且与探测分类器不同（Belinkov，2022），我们无需访问内部表示。 最后，由于系统一模型会暴露概率信息，我们还关注其置信度是否对高风险决策发出警示（Guo 等人，2017；Kadavath 等人，2022）。

paragraphs.en: A decision state s s consists of a task goal g g , the executed history h 1 : t = ( a 1 , o 1 , … , a t , o t ) h_{1:t}=(a_{1},o_{1},\dots,a_{t},o_{t}) of actions and the observations they produced, any rules R R that govern the environment or policy, and the set 𝒜 ⁡ ( s ) \mathcal{A}(s) of admissible next actions. The model receives s s and must choose one element of 𝒜 ⁡ ( s ) \mathcal{A}(s) ; it is never asked to generate an action. We call this the closed-world principle: every admissible action is placed in context with its canonical name and a description, nothing is shortlisted, and the gold action is never the only well-formed option. Actions with open arguments, such as tool calls, are enumerated from the environment or database. When a flat list would exceed the interface limit of 255 options, the call is factorized into one choice for the tool and one per closed-set argument, and scored as a complete call. Candidate sets come from the environment, from code, or from the dataset as released; no language model proposes candidates at evaluation time, since that would measure the proposer rather than the System One model.
paragraphs.zh: 决策状态 s 包含任务目标 g、已执行的动作与观测序列 h_{1:t}=(a_{1},o_{1},\dots,a_{t},o_{t})、约束环境或策略的任何规则 R，以及可接受的后续动作集合 \mathcal{A}(s)。 模型接收到 s 后必须从 \mathcal{A}(s) 中选择一个元素；它绝不会被要求生成一个动作。 我们称之为封闭世界原则：每个可接受的动作都会与其规范名称和描述一同置于上下文中，没有任何动作会被预先筛选，且黄金动作绝不会是唯一格式正确的选项。 具有开放参数的动作（如工具调用）会从环境或数据库中枚举出来。 当平铺列表会超过接口 255 个选项的限制时，该调用会被分解为对工具的一次选择和每个封闭集合参数的一次选择，并作为完整调用进行评分。 候选集来自环境、代码或已发布的数据集；在评估阶段，没有任何语言模型会提出候选项，因为那样衡量的是提议者，而非 System One 模型本身。

paragraphs.en: Which families apply depends on the domain, and we report coverage per domain (§ 3 ). Probes are closed questions with all candidate answers listed. Each question, whether probe or decision, is answered in isolation. Several questions about one state may share a request, as the interface allows, but each is answered on the state alone: no question or answer is added to another question’s input, and no gold fact is revealed. “Paired” therefore means that the input state is identical. It does not mean that we observe successive stages of the model’s computation.
paragraphs.zh: 哪些家庭适用取决于具体领域，我们将在每个领域分别报告覆盖范围（第 3 节）。 探测问题为封闭式问题，所有候选答案均已列出。 每个问题，无论是探测问题还是决策问题，都独立回答。 关于同一状态的多个问题可以共享一个请求（接口允许如此），但每个问题仅基于该状态单独回答：不会将任何问题或答案添加到另一个问题的输入中，也不会揭示任何黄金事实。因此，“成对”意味着输入状态完全相同。 这并不意味着我们观察了模型计算的连续阶段。

paragraphs.en: Records come in difficulty cells nested in task groups. The main text reports raw counts pooled over all 19,663 paired test states (or over the states of a study). paragraphs.en: that is, if some action is correct no matter which of these states the agent is in. If two states have the same correct probe answers but disjoint gold sets, then answering every probe correctly cannot by itself determine the right action, so a wrong action after correct probes cannot be attributed to deciding alone. Pairwise intersections are not enough; the check must consider the whole group. In finite, fully enumerable environments it can be run exhaustively. In natural data, finding no counterexample in a sample does not prove sufficiency. Context that the probes do not ask about, such as rules or tool availability, must either be held fixed or be probed. Passing the check means the probes can support a diagnosis. It does not show that the model actually uses those facts.
paragraphs.zh: 也就是说，如果无论智能体处于这些状态中的哪一个，某个行动都是正确的。 如果两个状态具有相同的正确探针答案，但它们的黄金答案集合不相交，那么仅凭正确回答所有探针问题本身无法确定正确的行动，因此，在探针结果正确之后采取错误行动，不能归因于仅依赖判断。 成对交集并不足够；检查必须考虑整个群体。 在有限且完全可枚举的环境中，可以对其进行穷举运行。 在自然数据中，样本中未找到反例并不能证明充分性。 探针未涉及的背景信息（例如规则或工具可用性）必须保持固定，或者也需要通过探针进行检验。 通过检查意味着这些探针能够支持诊断。 这并未表明模型实际上使用了这些事实。

sents.en: Agent decision states are the core; a supporting track of text-understanding primitives measures abilities that agent decisions draw on, such as multi-hop and long-context reading.

sents.en: We describe the agent states here.
sents.zh: 我们在本节中描述这些智能体状态。

paragraphs.en: Simulators give exact ground truth for both actions and facts, so most paired states come from three of them. In ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) we use the unseen evaluation games, plus the seen games as a separate cell; in BabyAI-Text we use BALROG’s text rendering ( Paglieri et al., 2025 ; Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ; Carta et al., 2023 ) ; and in TextWorld we generate cooking games at four TALES difficulty settings ( Côté et al., 2018 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . Trajectories are rolled out by the environment’s own expert, by a noisy variant that takes a uniformly random admissible action with probability 0.2, and by a variant that issues invalid commands. This puts failures, error feedback and detours into the traces, which successful demonstrations rarely contain. No language model takes part in the roll-outs.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟器能为动作和事实提供精确的基准真相，因此大多数成对状态都来自其中三个模拟器。 在 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）中，我们使用未见过的评估游戏，并将已见过的游戏作为独立单元格；在 BabyAI-Text 中，我们使用 BALROG 的文本渲染功能（Paglieri 等人，2025；Chevalier-Boisvert 等人，2019；Carta 等人，2023）；而在 TextWorld 中，我们在四个 TALES 难度设置下生成烹饪游戏（Côté 等人，2018；Cui 等人，2025）。 轨迹由环境自身的专家智能体、一个以 0.2 概率采取均匀随机可接受动作的噪声变体智能体，以及一个发出无效命令的变体智能体进行展开。 这使得失败、错误反馈和绕路等情况被记录到轨迹中，而这些在成功的演示中很少出现。 没有任何语言模型参与轨迹展开过程。

paragraphs.en: Gold actions use only what the trace reveals. For each state we build a map from the observations so far and compute the first actions of all shortest plans. A state is determinable when the needed objects have already been observed and the gold set is the same whether unseen cells are assumed free, assumed blocked, or taken from the true map. Otherwise it is an exploration state, whose gold is the set of actions that reveal unseen locations. Sampled items were checked against breadth-first search in the real environments; for example, 234 of 234 BabyAI items and 63 of 63 TextWorld items matched. Probe answers are read from the simulator state.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金行动仅使用轨迹所揭示的信息。 对于每个状态，我们基于迄今的观察构建一张地图，并计算所有最短规划的首个行动。 当所需对象已被观察到，且无论将未见的单元格视为自由、视为阻塞还是取自真实地图，黄金集合都保持一致时，该状态即为可确定的。 否则，它就是一个探索状态，其黄金集合是揭示未见位置的行动集合。 在真实环境中对采样项进行了广度优先搜索的验证；例如，234个BabyAI项中有234个匹配，63个TextWorld项中有63个匹配。 探测答案从模拟器的状态中读取。

paragraphs.en: On these environments we build the ladders and controls of § 2.5 . ALFWorld cells vary trace length, and a distance ladder inserts valid but irrelevant steps between the decisive observation and the decision. Observation minimal pairs move a sighting to another receptacle. Novelty cells rename objects and verbs or replace action names with opaque identifiers while keeping their descriptions. BabyAI and TextWorld cells follow the environments’ difficulty levels. Confirmation cohorts generated later from new seeds re-test the main findings on states that no earlier run had seen. Separate TextWorld cohorts change the rules of cooking in the game description, so that prior knowledge about recipes no longer applies.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些环境中，我们构建 § 2.5 中的阶梯和控制机制。 ALFWorld 的单元格会改变痕迹长度，而距离阶梯会在决定性观察与决策之间插入有效但无关的步骤。 观察最小对会将一次观察转移到另一个容器。 新颖性单元格会重命名物体和动词，或用不透明的标识符替换动作名称，同时保留其描述。 BabyAI 和 TextWorld 的单元格遵循各自环境的难度等级。 之后由新种子生成的确认组会重新测试主要发现，针对早期任何运行均未见过的状态。 独立的 TextWorld 组会改变游戏描述中的烹饪规则，使关于食谱的先验知识不再适用。

paragraphs.en: From τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench airline and retail ( Barres et al., 2026 ) we take decision states from recorded and native trajectories. Tool calls are enumerated from the task database, and probes ask about record fields and whether a policy permits an action. Minimal pairs edit one policy-relevant field so that the correct call changes, or edit an irrelevant field so that it does not. A native recovery panel places the agent after a failed or incomplete call.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 的航空和零售领域（Barres 等人，2026）中，从记录轨迹和本地轨迹中提取决策状态。 工具调用来自任务数据库的枚举，而探针则询问记录字段以及策略是否允许某项操作。 最小对通过修改一个与策略相关的字段来改变正确的调用，或者通过修改一个无关字段使其不改变。 本地恢复面板会在调用失败或不完整时将智能体置于后续状态。

paragraphs.en: AgentRM trees supply all sibling actions at a node together with value estimates ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . Mind2Web supplies all candidate page elements and operations ( Deng et al., 2023 ) . Toucan trajectories, ToolRet, BFCL and When2Call supply tool selection over full tool lists that include tools the model has not seen, as well as the choice between calling a tool, asking the user, and abstaining ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Patil et al., 2025 ; Ross et al., 2025 ) . These sources have no native comprehension labels. A separate panel adds visible-field probes, whose answers are stated explicitly in the trace, to a subset of them.
paragraphs.zh: AgentRM trees 在某个节点上同时提供所有兄弟动作及其价值估计（Xia 等人，2025）。 Mind2Web 提供所有候选页面元素和操作（Deng 等人，2023）。 Toucan trajectories、ToolRet、BFCL 和 When2Call 在包含模型从未见过的工具的完整工具列表中提供工具选择，并支持在调用工具、询问用户或不采取行动之间做出选择（Xu 等人，2026；Shi 等人，2025；Patil 等人，2025；Ross 等人，2025）。 这些来源没有内置的理解标签。 一个独立的模块为其中一部分来源添加了可见域探针，其答案在轨迹中被明确说明。

paragraphs.en: To test feedback reading in software agents without asking the model to write code, we build 360 records from real SWE-smith repository images. Each case combines two genuine patches to different files in the same repository, runs the published tests, and asks which edit caused a named check to regress, whether the displayed evidence is current or stale, and which limited next action follows. The 50 test source pairs span 17 repositories, which are disjoint from the 11 development repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不要求模型编写代码的情况下测试软件智能体的反馈读取能力，我们从真实的 SWE-smith 仓库图像中构建了 360 条记录。 每个案例都结合了对同一仓库中不同文件的两个真实补丁，运行已发布的测试，并询问哪项修改导致了某个指定检查的退化、显示的证据是最新的还是过时的，以及接下来应采取哪种有限的行动。 这 50 对测试源代码来自 17 个仓库，这些仓库与 11 个开发仓库互不重叠。

paragraphs.en: AgentRewardBench, R-Judge and Who&When ask for judgments about a completed trajectory, namely success, side effects, safety and the failing step ( Lù et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We report them as a separate family, since they are not next-action decisions.

paragraphs.en: Twenty-four task groups (32,700 test records) measure negation, multi-hop reasoning, long context with distractors, multi-turn recollection and correction, new label definitions, counterfactual rules, and logical reasoning. Each group is arranged along a difficulty ladder, for example hop count or context length. Sources include CondaQA, ScoNe, ProofWriter, CLUTRR, MuSiQue, BABILong, CLINC150, MASSIVE, CLadder and BoardgameQA, together with programmatic generators ( Ravichander et al., 2022 ; She et al., 2023 ; Tafjord et al., 2021 ; Sinha et al., 2019 ; Trivedi et al., 2022 ; Kuratov et al., 2024 ; Larson et al., 2019 ; FitzGerald et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2023 ; Kazemi et al., 2023 ) . These records have no paired probes. They allow boundaries in general reading to be compared with boundaries in agent decisions; this paper does not analyze them and does not use them as a measure of next-action skill.
paragraphs.zh: 24个任务组（32,700条测试记录）用于评估否定、多跳推理、包含干扰项的长上下文、多轮回忆与纠正、新标签定义、反事实规则以及逻辑推理。 每个任务组都按照难度阶梯进行排列，例如按跳数或上下文长度排序。 数据来源包括 CondaQA、ScoNe、ProofWriter、CLUTRR、MuSiQue、BABILong、CLINC150、MASSIVE、CLadder 和 BoardgameQA，以及程序化生成器（Ravichander 等，2022；She 等，2023；Tafjord 等，2021；Sinha 等，2019；Trivedi 等，2022；Kuratov 等，2024；Larson 等，2019；FitzGerald 等，2023；Jin 等，2023；Kazemi 等，2023）。 这些记录没有配对的探针。 它们使得通用阅读中的边界可以与智能体决策中的边界进行比较；本文并未分析这些边界，也未将其用作衡量下一步行动能力的指标。

paragraphs.en: Records are split into dev and test by a hash of their source group (game, user, repository), so no source contributes to both splits. Dev is used for template and pipeline checks and for selecting the reasoning reference, and is always reported separately from test. The target is 300 test records per difficulty cell, sampled with matched pairs across cells where a ladder requires them. The full population, including every request byte, option order and label, is frozen in a hash-sealed manifest before analysis, and all systems receive the identical requests. An independent content audit found 42 test records with conflicting labels outside the control groups and 56 test records whose inputs also occur in dev. We keep the frozen population unchanged and report a sensitivity analysis that excludes these 98 records. Public training games cannot be assumed unseen by pretrained models, which is one reason we add freshly generated confirmation cohorts. Fixed public items can also be overfit. The generators we use for the follow-up studies, including one for decision states whose probes are sufficient by construction (§ 6.1 ), can draw new evaluation states at any time.
paragraphs.zh: 记录根据其源组（游戏、用户、仓库）的哈希值被划分为开发集和测试集，因此没有任何一个源同时出现在两个划分中。 开发集用于模板和流程的检查，以及推理参考的选择，并且始终与测试集分开报告。 每个难度单元的目标是 300 条测试记录，这些记录通过跨单元匹配对的方式采样，以满足阶梯结构的要求。 完整的数据总体（包括每个请求字节、选项顺序和标签）在分析前被冻结到一个哈希密封的清单中，所有系统都接收到完全相同的请求。 一项独立的内容审计发现，有 42 条测试记录的控制组外标签存在冲突，另有 56 条测试记录的输入也出现在开发集中。 我们保持冻结的数据总体不变，并报告了一项排除这 98 条记录的影响分析。 不能假设公开的训练游戏对预训练模型而言是完全未接触过的，这也是我们添加新生成确认队列的原因之一。 固定的公开项目也可能出现过拟合。 我们在后续研究中使用的生成器（包括一个用于决策状态的生成器，其探测项根据设计已足够（§ 6.1）），可以在任何时间生成新的评估状态。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists the seventeen fast systems and the reasoning reference, grouped by type. Fourteen are System One models, which return a native distribution over the supplied options in one pass. Two are hosted APIs: JEV and OpenAI Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . Ten are released open-weight models that we serve locally, pinned to released revisions, each with its authors’ own serving code and documented settings: Clef-27B, Kev-9B, CLM-8B, Laya, Eikos-27B, Perplexity Decider-27B, SimpleJev-27B, Vega-27B, Torchcast-27B and Quyet-1.0-Large. Two are published recipes that read a frozen open-weight language model through the same interface: Cygnet reads masked single-letter probabilities of Gemma-4-12B, scores long option lists in groups of 20 and calibrates the result, and Decider-chat-31B reads the answer-letter distribution of Gemma-4-31B-it with a temperature that depends on the number of options. The three open-weight language models are scored by complete-option likelihood with thinking disabled. We render the state, question and enumerated options with the model’s chat template, sum the log probabilities of each option’s full name followed by the end-of-turn token, and normalize over the options. This exposes a full distribution that is directly comparable in form to those of the System One models. A hosted reasoning model (GPT-6.1 Sol, medium reasoning) answers each question in a separate call with the selected option and a verbalized distribution. It serves as a reference with deliberation, not as a competitor to the System One models; it answered all 174,513 questions of the benchmark (322 answers could not be parsed and count as wrong). Further released System One models are being evaluated with the same client, request format and run records; we report only systems for which every record and every condition is complete.
paragraphs.zh: 表1按类型分组列出了十七个快速系统及其推理参考。 其中十四种是系统一模型，它们在一次处理中即返回所提供选项上的原生分布。 两种是托管API：JEV和OpenAI Decisions（OpenAI，2026a）。 十种是已发布的开放权重模型，我们在本地运行这些模型，并锁定其已发布的版本；每个模型都包含作者自己的服务代码和文档说明的设置：Clef-27B、Kev-9B、CLM-8B、Laya、Eikos-27B、Perplexity Decider-27B、SimpleJev-27B、Vega-27B、Torchcast-27B和Quyet-1.0-Large。 两种是已发布的实现方案，它们通过相同的接口读取冻结的开放权重语言模型：Cygnet读取Gemma-4-12B的掩码单字母概率，以每组20个选项的形式对长选项列表进行评分并校准结果；而Decider-chat-31B则读取Gemma-4-31B-it的答案字母分布，其温度取决于选项数量。 这三种开放权重语言模型通过完整选项的似然度进行评分，且禁用思考功能。 我们使用模型的聊天模板渲染状态、问题和枚举选项，计算每个选项全称后接回合结束标记的对数概率之和，并对所有选项进行归一化。 这样便得到了一个完整的分布，其形式可以直接与系统一模型的结果进行比较。 一个托管推理模型（GPT-6.1 Sol，中等推理）通过单独调用回答每个问题，返回所选选项和以文字形式表达的分布。 该模型作为带有审慎推理的参考模型，而非系统一模型的竞争者；它回答了基准测试中的全部174,513个问题（其中322个答案无法解析，计为错误）。 其他已发布的系统一模型正在使用相同的客户端、请求格式和运行记录进行评估；我们仅报告那些所有记录和所有条件均完整的系统。

sents.en: Table 1 lists the seventeen fast systems and the reasoning reference, grouped by type.
sents.zh: 表1按类型分组列出了十七个快速系统及其推理参考。

sents.en: Fourteen are System One models, which return a native distribution over the supplied options in one pass.
sents.zh: 其中十四种是系统一模型，它们在一次处理中即返回所提供选项上的原生分布。

sents.en: Two are hosted APIs: JEV and OpenAI Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026a ) .
sents.zh: 两种是托管API：JEV和OpenAI Decisions（OpenAI，2026a）。

sents.en: Ten are released open-weight models that we serve locally, pinned to released revisions, each with its authors’ own serving code and documented settings: Clef-27B, Kev-9B, CLM-8B, Laya, Eikos-27B, Perplexity Decider-27B, SimpleJev-27B, Vega-27B, Torchcast-27B and Quyet-1.0-Large.
sents.zh: 十种是已发布的开放权重模型，我们在本地运行这些模型，并锁定其已发布的版本；每个模型都包含作者自己的服务代码和文档说明的设置：Clef-27B、Kev-9B、CLM-8B、Laya、Eikos-27B、Perplexity Decider-27B、SimpleJev-27B、Vega-27B、Torchcast-27B和Quyet-1.0-Large。

sents.en: Two are published recipes that read a frozen open-weight language model through the same interface: Cygnet reads masked single-letter probabilities of Gemma-4-12B, scores long option lists in groups of 20 and calibrates the result, and Decider-chat-31B reads the answer-letter distribution of Gemma-4-31B-it with a temperature that depends on the number of options.
sents.zh: 两种是已发布的实现方案，它们通过相同的接口读取冻结的开放权重语言模型：Cygnet读取Gemma-4-12B的掩码单字母概率，以每组20个选项的形式对长选项列表进行评分并校准结果；而Decider-chat-31B则读取Gemma-4-31B-it的答案字母分布，其温度取决于选项数量。

sents.en: The three open-weight language models are scored by complete-option likelihood with thinking disabled.
sents.zh: 这三种开放权重语言模型通过完整选项的似然度进行评分，且禁用思考功能。

sents.en: We render the state, question and enumerated options with the model’s chat template, sum the log probabilities of each option’s full name followed by the end-of-turn token, and normalize over the options.
sents.zh: 我们使用模型的聊天模板渲染状态、问题和枚举选项，计算每个选项全称后接回合结束标记的对数概率之和，并对所有选项进行归一化。

sents.en: This exposes a full distribution that is directly comparable in form to those of the System One models.
sents.zh: 这样便得到了一个完整的分布，其形式可以直接与系统一模型的结果进行比较。

sents.en: A hosted reasoning model (GPT-6.1 Sol, medium reasoning) answers each question in a separate call with the selected option and a verbalized distribution.
sents.zh: 一个托管推理模型（GPT-6.1 Sol，中等推理）通过单独调用回答每个问题，返回所选选项和以文字形式表达的分布。

sents.en: It serves as a reference with deliberation, not as a competitor to the System One models; it answered all 174,513 questions of the benchmark (322 answers could not be parsed and count as wrong).
sents.zh: 该模型作为带有审慎推理的参考模型，而非系统一模型的竞争者；它回答了基准测试中的全部174,513个问题（其中322个答案无法解析，计为错误）。

sents.en: Further released System One models are being evaluated with the same client, request format and run records; we report only systems for which every record and every condition is complete.
sents.zh: 其他已发布的系统一模型正在使用相同的客户端、请求格式和运行记录进行评估；我们仅报告那些所有记录和所有条件均完整的系统。

paragraphs.en: Every system receives the same frozen request: the same state, question text, options, descriptions and option order. We never truncate a state, drop options or reselect records to fit a system. When a request exceeds a system’s documented input limit, the question is recorded as unsupported, counted wrong, and reported as coverage. This affects Laya (512 input tokens, and option lists longer than its 192-token head budget), Cygnet (726 records over its 16k context) and Gemma (4 records over 32k). It also affects Quyet-1.0-Large, whose runtime refuses questions with more than ten options, which includes every ALFWorld decision: only 3.8% of paired test states have all of its answers supported. Perplexity Decider-27B refuses questions whose prompt exceeds 8,192 tokens (9.3% of paired states have a refused answer, mostly in τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench and the visible-field probes); Decider-chat-31B and OpenAI Decisions refuse 0.3–0.4%. Vega-27B’s server runs out of memory on the longest states on one 80 GB H100; after three failures on a healthy server we record such a question as unsupported (9,237 answers; 5.0% of paired states), and SimpleJev-27B’s server fails repeatedly on the longest states (13,119 answers recorded as unsupported after the same rules; 6.6% of paired states). Two author runtimes shorten long states themselves before reading them (Table 1 ); we report them as shipped. Readouts differ across systems by design, so comparisons are between deployed choice interfaces. They do not isolate the effect of architecture, model size or training data. Where an analysis uses a subset of questions, a system that answers fewer than half of them is left out of that analysis and named (the coverage rule ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个系统都接收到相同的固定请求：相同的状态、问题文本、选项、描述和选项顺序。 我们绝不会为了适配某个系统而截断状态、删除选项或重新选择记录。 当请求超出某系统文档中规定的输入限制时，该问题将被记录为不支持，计为错误，并报告为覆盖范围问题。 这会影响 Laya（输入令牌数超过 512，且选项列表长度超过其 192 令牌的头部预算）、Cygnet（记录数超过 726，超出其 16k 上下文限制）和 Gemma（记录数超过 4，超出 32k 限制）。 这也影响了 Quyet-1.0-Large，其运行时拒绝处理包含超过十个选项的问题，而 ALFWorld 的所有决策都包含这种情况：仅 3.8% 的成对测试状态的所有答案都得到了支持。 Perplexity Decider-27B 会拒绝提示超过 8,192 令牌的问题（9.3% 的成对状态存在被拒绝的答案，主要出现在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench 和可见域探针中）；Decider-chat-31B 和 OpenAI Decisions 的拒绝率则为 0.3–0.4%。 Vega-27B 的服务器在处理最长的状态时会在单台 80 GB H100 上耗尽内存；在健康服务器上发生三次故障后，我们会将此类问题记录为不支持（9,237 个答案；占成对状态的 5.0%），而 SimpleJev-27B 的服务器在处理最长的状态时反复失败（根据相同规则，13,119 个答案被记录为不支持；占成对状态的 6.6%）。 两位作者的运行时会在读取长状态之前先缩短这些状态本身（表 1）；我们将其报告为已发布版本。 不同系统的读取结果因设计而异，因此比较应基于已部署的选择界面进行。 这些比较并未隔离架构、模型规模或训练数据的影响。 如果分析仅使用部分问题，那么回答数量不足一半的系统将被排除在该分析之外并予以注明（覆盖范围规则）。

paragraphs.en: All seventeen fast systems and the reasoning reference receive all 65,228 records, including every paired test state. The trace-ablation condition was run for all seventeen fast systems on the 10,897 original agent records that carry it. Closed-loop execution, in which a System One model acts as the policy in a live environment, is outside the scope of this paper’s results.
paragraphs.zh: 全部十七个快速系统以及推理参考模型都接收了所有 65,228 条记录，包括每一对测试状态。 在所有携带该条件的 10,897 条原始智能体记录上，对全部十七个快速系统执行了痕迹消融实验。 闭环执行（即 System One 模型在真实环境中充当策略）不属于本文研究结果的范畴。

sents.zh: 全部十七个快速系统以及推理参考模型都接收了所有 65,228 条记录，包括每一对测试状态。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy runs batch requests for throughput, so their timings are not latency. We therefore time a separate fixed latency panel of 163 test items, one per main difficulty cell, so that every group, context length (37 to 99k characters), question count (1–8) and option count (2–255) is represented. Each system answers all questions of an item in one request, strictly sequentially, after five untimed warm-up items. We run three passes in reshuffled order and report the first pass, excluding the warm-up items; repeated passes, which benefit from caches, are reported separately. Only complete answers count toward latency, and refusals are reported as coverage. For pairs of systems we also report the median of per-request time ratios on the requests both answer, which is more robust than a ratio of medians. Seven systems, marked in Table 1 , were not timed on this panel. Their accuracy runs, unlike those of the other systems, send one request at a time to a server on its own H100 (or, for OpenAI Decisions, to the hosted API), so we estimate their latency from those runs on the same 158 timed panel items; these estimates lack the panel’s warm-up and are marked separately in Figure 2 . The reasoning reference answers one question per request, so we time it through its synchronous API on the same panel and order, sending the questions of an item in parallel; all 158 timed items were answered, with a median of 2.3 s per item, about eleven times JEV’s.
paragraphs.zh: 准确性测试通过批量请求来衡量吞吐量，因此其计时结果并非延迟。 因此，我们对一个包含 163 个测试项目的独立固定延迟面板进行计时，每个主要难度单元各一个项目，以确保每个组别、上下文长度（37 至 99k 字符）、问题数量（1–8）和选项数量（2–255）都有代表性。 每个系统在一次请求中回答某个测试项目的全部问题，且严格按顺序进行，在此之前会先处理五个不计时的热身项目。 我们以重新打乱顺序的方式运行三轮测试，并报告第一轮的结果，同时排除热身项目；重复运行因能利用缓存而表现不同，其结果将单独报告。 只有完整的回答才会计入延迟统计，而拒绝回答的情况则作为覆盖范围报告。 对于成对的系统，我们还会报告两者均有响应的请求中，单次请求时间比值的中间值，这一指标比中间值的比值更具稳健性。 表 1 中标记的七个系统未在此面板上进行计时测试。 与其余系统的准确性测试不同，这些系统在运行时每次仅向位于其自有 H100 上的服务器发送一个请求（对于 OpenAI Decisions，则发送至托管 API），因此我们基于它们在相同 158 个计时面板项目上的运行结果估算其延迟；这些估算值未包含面板中的热身环节，并在图 2 中单独标注。 推理参考模型每次请求仅回答一个问题，因此我们通过其同步 API 在相同的面板和顺序下对其计时，并将某个测试项目中的问题并行发送；全部 158 个计时项目均得到回答，平均每个项目的中间时间为 2.3 秒，约为 JEV 的十一倍。

paragraphs.en: System One models emphasize intelligence per dollar, so we report cost next to accuracy (Figure 2 ). The hosted JEV model was billed for 209.2M input tokens over all 65,228 records, $8.79 in total or $0.13 per 1,000 decision states. For self-hosted systems we estimate cost from the panel’s time per state at a stated GPU price; all were timed on the same hardware class, one request at a time (for the self-hosted systems not timed on it, from their accuracy runs; § D ). On these estimates the efficient frontier runs from Laya and Kev-9B through Cygnet, Decider-chat-31B and JEV to Eikos-27B and Gemma-4-31B. Eikos-27B reaches 0.795 at an estimated $0.19 per 1,000 states, about 1.4 times JEV’s measured cost, and displaces Clef-27B from the frontier; moving from JEV to Gemma raises paired decision accuracy from 0.763 to 0.811 at about five times the cost per state, while the Qwen readouts and CLM are dominated. The second hosted decision model, OpenAI Decisions, was billed for 186.9M input tokens on the 65,228 records ($18.69 at $0.10 per million input tokens, output free), $0.29 per 1,000 decision states or about twice JEV’s cost, for a paired decision accuracy of 0.706. The reasoning reference is shown for orientation only: its full run cost $642.00 under batch pricing, $9.84 per 1,000 decision states or about 73 times JEV, for a paired decision accuracy of 0.884 (§ 5.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Open models are pinned to released revisions and served with recorded configurations. JEV is pinned by its version string ( jev-1.13.0 ), but its provider does not promise long-term support for a version, and hosted serving can change or fail: during one check on 5 October 2026, 16 of 24 minimal requests returned server errors. We therefore re-ran the decision question alone on a stratified sample (up to 25 per cell) of 2,783 paired test states on 6 October, after the formal runs had finished on 1 October. The selected action matched the formal run on 96.3% of states (2,681/2,783). Because the formal requests also carried the probe questions, this agreement bounds the combined effect of version drift, serving nondeterminism and request packing; it does not isolate any one of them. OpenAI Decisions is a public beta identified only by its model name ( gpt-6-luna ); all of its records were collected on 11 October 2026. We keep all raw requests, full output distributions and timestamps, so that later versions can be compared on identical inputs.

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld can place several receptacles at one native location (for example a countertop and a coffee machine). The builder of the original cohorts mapped the agent’s location to one representative receptacle, chosen by fact order, and derived the location probe, the sightings and the set of visited receptacles from that mapping. We re-derived all three from the text of the trace with ALFWorld’s fixed message patterns (“You arrive at R”, “On the R, you see”, “You open the R”, “You pick up”, “You move”, “You cool/heat/clean”, “Nothing happens”), without simulator facts. Table 7 lists the disagreements. In every inspected location case, the text states that the agent arrived at a different receptacle from the label; for the 303 paired test records with such a label, JEV, Qwen3.8-27B, Cygnet and Gemma answer the receptacle named in the text in 297–301 cases. The extra gold options are lenient rather than wrong, since a co-located receptacle can be acted on from the same location. Among the observation minimal pairs, most seen-at disagreements are edited sightings that a later visit to the same receptacle contradicts. The confirmation cohort already uses set-valued location labels. We keep the frozen labels; excluding the 398 records with a location or seen-at disagreement raises, for every strong system, the share of ALFWorld decision errors made with all measured facts correct (Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: ALFWorld 可以在一个原始位置放置多个容器（例如一个操作台和一台咖啡机）。 原始群体的构建者将智能体的位置映射到一个代表性的容器上，该容器按事实顺序选定，并基于此映射推导出位置探针、观察记录以及已访问的容器集合。 我们利用 ALFWorld 固定的消息模式（“你到达 R”、“在 R 处，你看到”、“你打开 R”、“你拿起”、“你移动”、“你冷却/加热/清洁”、“无事发生”）以及文本中的轨迹信息，无需依赖模拟器的事实，重新推导出了上述三项内容。 表 7 列出了这些不一致之处。 在所有检查的位置案例中，文本均指出智能体到达的容器与标签所标示的不同；在 303 个带有此类标签的成对测试记录中，JEV、Qwen3.8-27B、Cygnet 和 Gemma 在 297 至 301 个案例中选择了文本中命名的容器。 额外的黄金选项属于宽松而非错误，因为位于同一位置的容器可以在相同位置进行操作。 在观察最小对样本中，大多数“观察到”的不一致情况，都是后续对同一容器的访问所推翻的编辑后的观察记录。 确认群体已经使用了集合值的位置标签。 我们保留这些固定的标签；排除那些存在位置或“观察到”不一致的 398 条记录后，对于每个强系统，在全部测量事实均正确的情况下仍发生的 ALFWorld 决策错误比例会上升（表 8）。

paragraphs.en: All probe answers are derived from the task sentence, the initial observation and the trace. For each state we ask: the agent’s location (all receptacles plus “the middle of the room”); what it holds (all objects seen plus “nothing”); for every object type the task still needs, where an instance was last seen that is still available (all receptacles plus “not seen yet”); whether the held target object has already been cleaned, heated or cooled; how many target objects are already in place (two-object tasks); for every receptacle, whether the agent has gone there; and the next sub-goal. Sub-goal categories are defined by mapping each admissible action through the parsed state: search (an unvisited receptacle), fetch (a receptacle where a needed object was seen), open the receptacle here, take a needed object, go to the appliance, process, go to the destination, place, use the lamp, and two residual categories (another object; look, examine or inventory). The gold sub-goal is the set of categories of the gold actions. States whose gold actions fall into a residual category or into a revisit of a searched receptacle were excluded; all inspected cases were co-located receptacles (Appendix E ). Of 705 sampled ALFWorld states, 644 remain. The probe request contains 26 questions per state on average.
paragraphs.zh: 所有探测答案均源自任务句、初始观察和轨迹。 对于每个状态，我们询问：智能体的位置（所有容器加上“房间中央”）；它持有的物品（所有已见物品加上“无”）；对于任务仍需要的每种物品类型，最后一个可见且仍在可用的实例出现在哪里（所有容器加上“尚未看到”）；所持有的目标物品是否已被清洁、加热或冷却；已有多少个目标物品被放置到位（双物品任务）；对于每个容器，智能体是否已去过那里；以及下一个子目标。 子目标类别通过解析状态中的每个允许动作来定义：搜索（一个未访问的容器）、获取（一个曾看到所需物品的容器）、在此打开容器、取走所需物品、前往电器处、处理、前往目的地、放置、使用灯具，以及两个剩余类别（另一个物品；查看、检查或清点）。 黄金子目标是黄金动作所对应的类别集合。 其黄金动作属于剩余类别或涉及重复访问已搜索容器的状态被排除在外；所有被检验的案例均为位于同一位置的容器（附录 E）。 在 705 个采样的 ALFWorld 状态中，有 644 个保留下来。 每个状态的探测请求平均包含 26 个问题。

paragraphs.en: The generator produces states in a household domain (a home robot following a house protocol) and an orders domain (a support agent following a refund policy). Each procedure is a decision list over four rule facts with a default action; the trace establishes eight binary facts (the four rule facts and four distractors) through observations, some of which are later overwritten. The action set is fixed per domain and includes actions licensed by the distractor facts, so a model that acts on any true fact can be wrong. Sufficiency (a unique gold action for every assignment of the four rule facts) is verified by enumeration. Dev seeds were used only for template checks; the 1,200 test states use disjoint seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器在家庭领域（遵循家庭协议的家用机器人）和订单领域（遵循退款政策的支持智能体）中生成状态。 每个程序都是基于四个规则事实的决策列表，并带有默认动作；该轨迹通过观察确立了八个二元事实（四个规则事实和四个干扰项），其中一些事实随后被覆盖。 动作集在每个领域中是固定的，并包含由干扰项事实授权的动作，因此任何对真实事实采取行动模型都可能出错。 充分性（即对于四个规则事实的每种赋值都存在唯一的黄金动作）通过枚举法得到验证。 Dev 种子仅用于模板检查；1,200 个测试状态则使用互不重叠的种子。

sents.zh: 每个程序都是基于四个规则事实的决策列表，并带有默认动作；该轨迹通过观察确立了八个二元事实（四个规则事实和四个干扰项），其中一些事实随后被覆盖。

sents.en: The action set is fixed per domain and includes actions licensed by the distractor facts, so a model that acts on any true fact can be wrong.
sents.zh: 动作集在每个领域中是固定的，并包含由干扰项事实授权的动作，因此任何对真实事实采取行动模型都可能出错。

sents.en: Sufficiency (a unique gold action for every assignment of the four rule facts) is verified by enumeration.
sents.zh: 充分性（即对于四个规则事实的每种赋值都存在唯一的黄金动作）通过枚举法得到验证。

sents.en: Dev seeds were used only for template checks; the 1,200 test states use disjoint seeds.
sents.zh: Dev 种子仅用于模板检查；1,200 个测试状态则使用互不重叠的种子。
